Placing Land Units in your Empire is deployment. Land Units are built in your Barracks.
Destroy {total} Land Units. Show no mercy.
Land Units can be destroyed in battles, including Survival Mode, World Domination and Battle Blitz.
Combine the tactical and combat resources of the competing teams and get into that bunker!
My reports tell me that the rival teams are working exceptionally well together, Commander. Disastrous as it turned out to be, the competition certainly brought them together.
Our task force has made it to the very core of the underground bunker. It is vital that they move with caution. We must know what's going on in that bunker!
Ask for {total} Flashbangs to disorient the enemy's senses.
Win {total} World Domination fights. You're not someone to mess with!
Pillage {total} times as you make your way further into that underground bunker.
Komşularınızı istila edip kaynak toplayın ya da Yıldırım Savaşları kazanın.
You've reached the heart of the bunker. It's ours for the taking!

Commander, our men have been ambushed inside the bunker! The few who made it back have reported that a New World Order exists underground. They are a totalitarian power elite supporting a one-world government.
It's time to regroup make one more last-ditch effort. Your mission is clear: take out the New World Order and rescue our men. Use whatever cover the night affords you. You must not fail.
Ask for {total} Night Vision Scopes to give our shooters greater accuracy underground.
Ask friends for Night Vision Scopes.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights. Bring the blitzkrieg upon them!
Harvest {total} Chili Peppers. Don't underestimate the power of this simple aid in fighting dirty.
Plant Chili Peppers in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
This is it. We have one shot at taking down this militant society and rescuing our boys.
You bring a tear to my eye, Commander. That New World Order is old news now. All that's left to do is celebrate this show of teamwork among competitive rivals!
Human organs are being traded in the black market outside of regulatory donor protocol. This is dirty business, Commander! I just hope I can keep my lunch down...
You can progress down both paths at once. The top path will earn you the SpecOps Wombat Tank and the bottom, the SpecOps Sea Hive Carrier!
On the agenda today: taking down a filthy organ trafficking ring. Your people need you now, more than ever!
I have some very unsettling news, Commander. My sources have run into an organ trafficking ring in the Empire. We must take it down!
You earned 5x SpecOps Sea Hive Carrier!

I have a great many questions regarding this stinking business. To start with, let's trace and interrogate some of the recipients of the organs. I hope they're willing to talk in exchange for immunity.
Ask for {total} Telephone Directories to help you contact previous organ recipients.
Gather {total} Wood. You never know when you'll need the extra supplies.
Kereste, Kereste Fabrikalarınızda üretilebilir ya da Ağaçlar temizlenerek elde edilebilir.
Gather {total} Oil for the transport vehicles conveying your interviewees.
Kendi Kuyularınızdan veya Komşularınızın Kuyularından toplayın, Komşulardan yağmalayın ya da savaşta kazanın.
Trace and interrogate the previous recipients of the black market organs. They might produce a lead or two.
Our preliminary investigations didn't throw a lot of light on the situation. We only managed to get a name: Lord Vaughn. I have no idea what that means... yet!

A report from the keeper of a halfway house says that several of the recently released ex-cons at his house have gone missing. My gut tells me that this might be connected to our current investigation. Do your digging!
Ask for {total} Parole Reports of the missing ex-convicts.
Build {total} Strike Teams for extra protection. You never know what an ex-con might do.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Harvest Corn {total} times to keep the ex-cons occupied in case things get unruly.
Çiftliklerinize Mısır ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
A report has come in about missing ex-cons. Could this be connected to our current case? Investigate!
Our investigations revealed that the missing convicts all took a small train out of a specific borough and never made it to their destinations. Coincidence? You know it's not.
The best way to find out how those ex-cons went missing is to step into their shoes! Disguise a small task force to fit the general profile of the missing cons and get yourselves onto that train!
Collect {total} Fake Tattoo Sleeves. A disguise is all about the details.
Ask friends for Fake Tattoo Sleeves.
Deploy {total} Strike Teams as backup in case things get out of hand.
İmparatorluğunuza yapılan istilaları püskürtürken Vurucu Tim gönderin. Onları Vurucu Tim Karargâhında kurun.
Deploy {total} Land Units at each station.
Placing Land Units in your Empire is deployment. Land Units are built in your Barracks.
Disguise your team as ex-convicts and set yourselves up on that train. There's nothing more effective than live bait
Did you hear that? Sounds of a scuffle a few cars away at that last stop... One of your men has been captured and taken off the train! Quick, after them before they disappear!
The boys in charge of the cargo cars have eyes everywhere. Let's see if we can get any useful information about these disappearances out of them. They might even know what 'Lord Vaughn' means!
Ask for {total} Harmonicas to bribe the cargo boys with. You know they love to rock the blues.
Revive Neighbors' Crops {total} times. People are always more willing to talk when you do them favors.
Click on withered Crops in your Neighbors' Empires to revive them.
Collect {total} times from Government Structures just in case the Harmonicas prove less than adequate.
Toplamak için İmparatorluğunuzdaki Devlet Binalarına tıklayın.
You're not above a little bribery, are you? Try questioning the cargo boys on the train. They have eyes everywhere.
Ask and ye shall receive! The boys claim that 'Lord Vaughn' is a cartel whose members hide in the cargo cars before overpowering unsuspecting passengers and carting them off at the last station.
One of your men has been captured! Your first priority is to follow his captors and rescue him before he finds himself lacking a kidney!
Collect {total} Smelling Salts to revive your unconscious comrade.
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode to prepare for an imminent showdown.
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
Build {total} LE Units to give yourself an edge over the cartel.
You can build LE units in the LE Unit Factory.
The cartel took the bait and captured one of your men. They'll lead you straight to their headquarters. Your mission: follow and rescue.
Very smooth, Commander! Now we know that the Lord Vaughn cartel works out of a decrepit, apparently abandoned hospital. Quite the fitting site for their foul operation!
You know what you have to do with that dynamite. Work fast, Commander. Lord Vaughn has already discovered your presence. Do what you do best and take them down!
Collect {total} Dynamite Sticks to blow that old hospital sky high.
Win {total} World Domination battles. Lord Vaughn won't know what hit them.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Pillage {total} times as you bring down the organ trafficking ring.
Komşularınızı istila edip kaynak toplayın ya da Yıldırım Savaşları kazanın.
Those things that go 'boom' will help you put an end to this abominable trade. Get them all, Commander!
You do love a good explosion! Lord Vaughn is now little more than spare parts. And thanks to you, those parts aren't going to see daylight for a long time!
An anonymous tip tells me that there's a pawn broker here who might know the significance of 'Lord Vaughn'. Find him and investigate under the guise of a customer in heavy debt.
Ask for {total} Trinkets to pawn. The broker will want to know you're legit.
Build {total} Power-Ups. You could try to pawn that too.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
Harvest {total} {nrare2}. It could be worth some solid information.
Collect from your own Mines or Neighbors' Mines, pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
There's a pawn broker who can tell us how to reach Lord Vaughn. He only imparts this information to his most desperate customers.
You played your part well! The broker slipped us a card with a phone number on it. Could this be the mysterious Lord Vaughn?
The number dials a 'charity' that offers to clear the debts of 'deserving, eligible candidates'. I can smell the bull***t right away, Commander. Find out what makes a candidate eligible, won't you?
Ask for {total} BS Detectors to you know, help you detect the bull***t.
Add {total} more space to your Army Depot. The extra space is sure to come in handy soon.
If you don't have an Army Depot, you'll find it in your inventory.
Repel {total} invasions from your Neighbors' Empires. They might have some useful information.
İstilacıları püskürtmeye yardım etmek için Arkadaşlarınızın İmparatorluklarını ziyaret edin.
The number rings an organization that clears the debts of 'deserving and eligible' candidates. Something's fishy here...

If I understood this correctly, 'eligible' candidates usually offer a kidney or part of their liver as a 'donation' before their debts are cleared. That's just... Surely people don't fall for this rubbish! Right?

Assemble a team of the sharpest hackers in the Empire and get into the charity's accounts. I'm positive we can trace the flow of money to and from this organization. There are bound to be some dirty trails!
Ask for {total} Hackers to help you hack into the charity's accounts.
Get {total} Domination War Chests. Make sure your men stay sharp as you investigate.
Kazandığınız her Hâkimiyet savaşında bir Savaş Sandığı alırsınız.
Earn {total} Black Hearts as you hack into the charity's records. You're not above playing dirty.
Başarıyla istila edip istila edilen Komşulardan toplayarak veya İmparatorluğunuzdaki istilaları püskürterek Kara Yürek kazanın.
If you can get into the charity's accounts, I'm sure we'll find some very interesting money trails...
Aha! Your hackers traced an incriminating chunk of the money to the account of a Dr. V. Jameson. A wild Lord Vaughn appears!
Let's take this bull by the horns, Commander! Raid the charity's private transplant facilities. The staff might be willing to talk in exchange for immunity. Don't forget to seize the organs!
Ask for {total} Organ Transplant Boxes to transport the facility's illegally acquired organs.
Ask friends for Organ Transplant Boxes.
Deal {total} Damage to the Land Units of the charity's security force.
You can use any Units when fighting Land Units.
Use {total} Power-Ups to give you an edge in battle.
Daha etkili savaşmak için Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
Raid the charity's private transplant facilities and seize control of their organ stash, Commander!
Nicely done! You even managed to acquire full confessions from the charity's staff. They cooperated to rat out their director, a Dr. V Jameson - the mysterious Lord Vaughn himself!
The manhunt begins. My sources tell me the good doctor has made an attempt to flee the Empire. Don't let him cross those borders!
Ask for {total} copies of the Miranda Rights to have handy when your men arrest Lord Vaughn.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights as you raid all the doctor's contacts in your Empire.
Harvest {total} Pineapples to celebrate his imminent capture. (Pineapples are so good for you!)
Çiftliklerinize Ananas ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümelerini bekleyin.
Lord Vaughn is trying to make his escape. Get on his tail, Commander! He must not reach the borders.
That was close. You stopped Lord Vaughn in his organ-dealing tracks just before he escaped the boundaries of your control. You never cease to impress me, Commander!

Sondra Fahs is a truly dangerous terrorist who has just escaped our grasp while en route to her trial. I'm sorry to report that it was one of our security guards that aided her escape. This is a very volatile situation we're in, Commander.
You can progress down both paths at once. The top path will earn you the SpecOps Pierce C-3 Fighter and the bottom, the SpecOps Lynna Copter!
Security breach! One of your security guards helped the terrorist Sondra Fahs escape on the way to her trial. Track her down!

One of the security guards transporting the international terrorist, Sondra Fahs, to the courthouse for her trial, helped her escape. The situation could get highly complicated if word gets out. Work fast to contain it and recapture her!
You earned 5x SpecOps Pierce C-3 Fighter!
We can't let word of this escape get out. Instruct your press secretary to leak a story to a foreign publication that a serious illness prevented Sondra Fahs from showing up at her trial.
Ask for {total} Press Releases to send out to international publications.
Earn {total} Red Hearts. Your allies shouldn't guess that anything's amiss.
Komşularınızı ziyaret edip onlara yardım edin veya Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarındaki istilaları püskürtün.
Gather {total} Wood to build a barricade around the courthouse to keep the press out.
Kereste, Kereste Fabrikalarınızda üretilebilir ya da Ağaçlar temizlenerek elde edilebilir.
News can travel like wildfire. Leak a false story that claims that an illness prevented Fahs from appearing at her trial.
The world bought the lie, Commander. We have contained a possible outbreak of panic. For now.

A rogue security guard and a dangerous terrorist can't be allowed to run free. An aggressive investigation is in order. The guard's family might know something; so might your underworld gang contacts.
Collect {total} Interrogation Tables to question the suspects.
Harvest Corn {total} times. Let no one accuse you of starving the suspects.
Çiftliklerinize Mısır ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
Build a Strike Team as a cautionary measure in case things get out of hand.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
An aggressive investigation is in order. The rogue guard's family and your underworld sources may have some information.
No leads yet, Commander. Perhaps you've run the 'good cop' routine to the ground. It's time for your 'bad cop' to make an appearance!
I noticed the rogue guard's wife twitching like a ferret on hot coals. I suspect she isn't being entirely honest with us. A second round of questioning could coax the truth out of her...
Collect {total} Tissue Boxes to stem the lady's waterworks.
Upgrade your Army Depot once. You'll be glad for the space later.
Upgrading lets you add more space to your Depot.
Build {total} Land Units to prepare for an imminent manhunt.
Land Units are built in your Barracks.
The guard's wife displayed some tell-tale signs of guilt and fear. A second round of questioning will coax the truth out of her.
The guard's wife had quite the sob story to share. It appears he cut a deal to help Fahs escape in return for money enough to care for his family.

One of our shadier sources has a tip for us: a location where Fahs might be holed up! While he isn't known to be the most reliable source, we can't ignore any leads at this point. Send in a squad to check it out.
Ask for {total} Squad Car Radios to call for back-up.
Ask friends for Squad Car Radios.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights and leave no stone unturned as you check out that lead.
Deploy {total} Strike Teams to supplement your squad.
İmparatorluğunuza yapılan istilaları püskürtürken Vurucu Tim gönderin. Onları Vurucu Tim Karargâhında kurun.
An underworld contact has come forward with a tip on Fahs' location. Send in a squad to check it out.
I could string him up by the eyebrows! He fed us a false lead and cost us some valuable time. I'll deal with him. You concentrate on finding Fahs.

Finally, a lead! An enormous sum of money has just been deposited into the guard's bank account. You may be able to trace the transfer. I know of a terror fighting coalition agency that can help you gain the details you need.
Ask for {total} Bank Statements to check through.
Harvest {total} Red Onions. Cyber traces can make you hungry.
Plant Red Onions in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
Pillage {total} times to keep your forces sharp and ready for battle.
Komşularınızı istila edip kaynak toplayın ya da Yıldırım Savaşları kazanın.
Trace the transfer of a generous sum into the guard's bank account with the help of a terror fighting coalition agency.
The agency helped us trace the transfer to an offshore account in a nation famous for protecting the identities of its paying customers. We're finally getting somewhere!

Our federal cyber experts have traced the location of the computer from where the transfer was done. It's a long shot, but let's move in. If we're lucky, we might just be able to capture Sondra Fahs and our errant guard.
Request {total} Squad Cars to haul the prisoners back to jail.
Deploy {total} Grunt Soldiers to help with the arrest.
Grunt Soldiers can be built in Barracks I
Win {total} World Domination battles as you move in on your targets.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
We've managed to track the computer that made the transfer! Surround the location. Our targets are close!

Bingo! It turns out that the desperate security guard forced the terrorist to make the transfer right away instead of waiting till things cooled off. Fahs sure is going to regret this stunt at her trial!

The terrorist group that Sondra Fahs belonged to must have figured out that their main girl escaped. We have suddenly been facing multiple bomb threats around the Empire. You must diffuse this situation fast!
Collect {total} Bomb Disposal Robots to equip your bomb squad.
Ask friends for Bomb Disposal Robots.
Gather {total} {nrare}. Your anti-terror squad will know what to do with it.
Bu cevher Süper Cevher Madeninizde üretilebilir ya da savaşta kazanılabilir.
Build a Power-Up to help your anti-terror squad.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
Upon Fahs' escape, our Empire has been facing bomb threats from the terrorist group she belongs to. You must diffuse this situation fast!
That was very ably handled, Commander. But it's too early for celebration. We have a mammoth task ahead of us.

You must nip this nastiness in the bud! You know that the group's hideout lies in the inhospitable hills of your ally's Empire. I suggest you conduct an air raid there. Don't forget to get your ally's permission first!
Ask for {total} Smart Suits for your diplomatic contingent to wear when you get your ally's consent.
Build {total} Bombers to conduct the raid.
Bombers can be built in your Hangar.
Upgrade your Air Depot once to make space for the extra Bombers.
Geliştirme, Depoya daha fazla yer eklemenizi sağlar.
The terrorist group's HQ lies in the hills in your ally's Empire. Ask your ally for permission and conduct an air raid over the HQ.
Well done, a few bombs dropped on the terrorists' heads will no doubt discourage them for a while!

An unrelated investigation into a local crime lord revealed that he has provided a safe house for the escapees and is arranging for cosmetic surgery to change their looks! Send in undercover agents to survey the house.
Round up {total} Cosmetic Surgeons who would have helped them escape.
Earn {total} Black Hearts as a sign that you don't spare your enemies.
Başarıyla istila edip istila edilen Komşulardan toplayarak veya İmparatorluğunuzdaki istilaları püskürterek Kara Yürek kazanın.
Repel {total} invasions from your Neighbors' Empires in return for their permission to conduct the raid.
İstilacıları püskürtmeye yardım etmek için Arkadaşlarınızın İmparatorluklarını ziyaret edin.
An unrelated inquiry revealed that a local crime lord is harboring the escapees and is arranging for cosmetic surgery to alter their looks!
Sondra Fahs went to great lengths to avoid capture! Had she succeeded, she'd be lost to us forever. Your timing was perfect!

I just received a tip from a gang about their rivals harboring Fahs and the rogue guard. Confront the boss and push him to set up an ambush. Fahs has already made this worth his while so you might have to use force to turn him.
Ask for {total} Telephone Operators to connect you to the right gang.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode in a display of strength.
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
Fight the gang and show them you mean business.
Pick your units wisely in the fight. The 'Fight' button will take you to the battle.
A tip revealed that a gang has been harboring the fugitives. You must persuade them to help you set a trap. Use force if necessary.
Excellent! Now that the gang boss knows who is boss, enlist their help to set up a trap for the fugitives. A deserted warehouse will do perfectly.

The stage is set. Fahs and the guard are due to arrive at the warehouse in minutes. They're expecting safe transport out of your Empire so they won't be happy to see your forces waiting for them. Take them down, Commander!
Ask for {total} Gauze Wraps for when things get messy.
Win {total} World Domination fights. Take Sondra Fahs and her rogue guard down!
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Harvest {total} Chili Peppers to add a little fire to your fight.
Plant Chili Peppers in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
The trap is set. Fahs and the guard expect to find safe transport waiting for them. You have the element of surprise on your side.
That'll be one for the books, Commander! The guard has been arrested and Fahs will make it to her trial after all. This stunt will not bode well for her.

The passengers of the luxury yacht are safe but the diplomat says that he could not salvage some high-value items that were stored in a vault onboard. The captain couldn't explain why the vessel began to sink. Something isn't right...
You earned 5x SpecOps Franklin B-2 Battleship!

The higher your game level, the better your reward! Players at levels 12 - 30 get the SpecOps Franklin B-2 Battleship I; levels 31 - 50 get the SpecOps Franklin B-2 Battleship II and levels 51+ get the SpecOps Franklin B-2 Battleship III.
A private yacht from one of your neighboring Empires is sinking mysteriously in your harbor. This has 'dirty' written all over it.

A diplomat from one of our neighboring Empires requested permission to dock his private yacht in our waters for the week. But the vessel mysteriously sent out distress reports before sinking a while later. Could an enemy be behind this?
There's something fishy afoot and I'm not talking about the inhabitants of the ocean! Call in your coast guard to scout around the yacht and keep the area clear.
Get {total} Nautical Telescopes to get a closer look at the sinking yacht.
Get {total} Energy by visiting Neighbors. See if they've spotted any unusual oceanic activity.
Help each Neighbor 5 times to get 1 Energy.
Collect {total} Oil. Your coast guard's boats are due for an oil change.
Collect from your own Wells or Neighbors' Wells, pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
Call in your coast guard to scout around the sinking yacht. These waters are never peaceful!
One of the boats on patrol spotted the periscope of a submarine some distance away but nothing showed up on their radar. Strange indeed!
I've sent divers down to discover what lies at the depths of the ocean. But I think they've run into a spot of trouble with an unidentified party. Find out what went down!
Ask for {total} Wetsuits for your divers to use.
Use the Experimental healing ability {total} times in Battle. Your divers are facing hostility.
The Medivac Chopper, Hospital Ship and Army Ambulance offer these healing abilities.
Earn {total} Black Hearts as a warning sign to hostile parties.
Başarıyla istila edip istila edilen Komşulardan toplayarak veya İmparatorluğunuzdaki istilaları püskürterek Kara Yürek kazanın.
I've sent divers to check out the sunken yacht, but they might have run into some trouble. Help them out!
Our men faced an unprovoked attack from the unidentified divers! We didn't catch them, but we got a clear view of the mysteriously undetectable submarine they escaped into.

Good news, Commander! Our intelligence agents finally got a valuable tip off and well, well, guess who's behind the mystery submarine and its evil diving minions? It's that greedy rat, Viper! Get your navy geared up for action!
Collect {total} Advanced Sonar Systems to locate the submarine.
Ask friends for Advanced Sonar Systems.
Deploy {total} Gunboats to launch an attack on Viper and his submarine.
Placing Gunboats in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Shipyard.
Build {total} Strike Team to support your forces.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
A lucky tip from our intelligence agents revealed that it's Viper behind the mystery submarine. Ready your Navy, Commander!
Excellent! Viper isn't going to know what hit him when we're through with him. He can't sink a yacht in our waters and get away with it!

Viper isn't as dumb as he looks! He's got some technology that keeps his submarine from being detected. Still, there's a faint blip on our advanced radar, so take a chance and fire a torpedo in his direction.
Ask for {total} Mark 30 Torpedoes to fire at Viper's submarine.
Deal {total} damage to Sea Units. Aim for Viper's submarine!
You can use any Units when fighting Sea Units.
Build {total} Power-Ups to improve your chances.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
Our advanced radars display a faint blip that must be Viper's sub. Torpedoes away!
Ah, unfortunately we missed. We need more than a blip for an accurate shot. But we must have given them a bit of a shakeup!

Take to the skies, Commander! Clearly, our torpedoes are having trouble homing in on Viper's sub. It's still only a faint blip on our tracking equipment, but I think we have a better chance of striking it via the sky...
Collect {total} Victory Flags to signal the enemy's defeat.
Deal {total} damage against Viper using Air Units. We're bound to hit him this way!
Use Air Units to fight battles and deal damage. Air Units can be built in your Hangar.
Deploy {total} Strike Teams to supplement your task force.
İmparatorluğunuza yapılan istilaları püskürtürken Vurucu Tim gönderin. Onları Vurucu Tim Karargâhında kurun.
Our torpedoes didn't meet their mark. It's time for an air strike on Viper's submarine!
Target destroyed! We blasted that sub right out of the water! But Viper and his crew escaped in a pre-prepared, smaller craft. We'll get them later. For now, let's get back to the sunken yacht.

Finally, after all those petty distractions, it's time to see what was on this yacht that created such a fuss with Viper. You'll want to keep some explosives handy. That safe is wedged tight between some wrecked rafters.
Collect {total} Detonators to blow up the safe.
Use {total} Power-Ups. The right Power-Up can make for a bigger bang.
Daha etkili savaşmak için savaşta Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
Collect {total} Domination War Chests as you clear your way to the safe.
Kazandığınız her Hâkimiyet savaşında bir Savaş Sandığı alırsınız.
Now that Viper's taken care of, let's see what it was on that yacht that he wanted to get his hands on so badly.
In a surprising twist, the safe is empty! Who could have stolen the loot? I'm quite certain Viper and his men didn't get near it!
There's definitely more to this than meets the eye. It's time to start asking some hard questions. Don't let anyone slip under your radar!
Collect {total} Lie Detectors to help narrow down the suspects.
Harvest {total} Wheat. Interrogation makes people hungry.
Çiftliklerinize Buğday ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
Repel {total} invasions from your Neighbors' Empires. Maintain those civil relationships!
İstilacıları püskürtmeye yardım etmek için Arkadaşlarınızın İmparatorluklarını ziyaret edin.
Something about this whole situation is definitely off. It's time to start questioning everyone involved...
Something the diplomat said immediately threw suspicion on his personal valet. But after a search, we found nothing. This is perplexing indeed, Commander!

Commander, this has just come to my attention: Viper has been sighted again and it looks like he has kidnapped the diplomat's wife! Get her back to safety and we might be able to clear this up once and for all.
Collect {total} Handcuffs to arrest the guilty ones.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights against Viper to rescue the diplomat's wife.
Win {total} World Domination fights to destroy Viper's forces.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Viper's back and he has kidnapped the diplomat's wife! Let's put an end to this farce right now.

Viper's 'hostage' was the mastermind behind the whole thing! The diplomat's wife hoped to fraudulently gain insurance money for the 'stolen' valuables. That would have been a pretty sum, even after Viper's cut!

I've been trying to master the science of artificial intelligence for years but I wasn't successful until Sierra happened. But now she's missing from my lab. I think someone bot-napped her! You must help me find her!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Trojan Infantry and SpecOps Roger M-77 Artillery; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Seabolt's A.I. robot, Sierra, has been stolen from his lab. Bad things could happen if she isn't found fast!
Sierra, my Artificial Intelligence prototype has disappeared from my lab! She can be extremely dangerous in the wrong hands. We must find her!
You earned 5x SpecOps Roger M-77 Artillery!
Er, you should know that Sierra currently has the petulant personality of an adolescent girl. She likes to be... difficult. But you must find her! She must be so scared...
Ask for {total} Forensic Analysts to help you examine the scene of the crime.
Collect {total} Oil for some comparative tests against a small spill in the lab.
Collect from your own Wells or Neighbors' Wells, pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
Earn {total} Red Hearts. Help out in whatever way you can.
Komşularınızı ziyaret edip onlara yardım edin veya Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarındaki istilaları püskürtün.
This lab clearly isn't very secure. Search it for clues as to who might have stolen my prototype.
We found one major clue: a tiny scrap of red silk! Our forensics experts tell us it matches the criminal profile of the Eel!

I haven't updated my video surveillance system in years, but you might still find something. Don't stop with just my lab, though. I want as many reports as you can get about the Eel's movements in the Empire!
Collect {total} Police Reports detailing every sighting of the Eel in your Empire.
Build {total} Strike Team to supplement your security force.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Pillage {total} times as you comb through your Empire.
How long has the Eel been hanging around our Empire?
I can't decide if this is good or bad news, but the reports showed that the Eel did indeed enter my lab. What's more, he might still be in our Empire!
Sierra's tracker revealed that the Eel has been hiding right under our noses in a concealed make-shift chamber, almost directly under my lab! Move in with a Special Reaction Team, Commander!
Collect {total} Members for a Special Reaction Team to move in on the Eel.
Ask friends for Special Reaction Team Members.
Deploy {total} Strike Teams along with the Special Reaction Team.
İmparatorluğunuza yapılan istilaları püskürtürken Vurucu Tim gönderin. Onları Vurucu Tim Karargâhında kurun.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights. Bring the 'blitz' to the Eel's doorstep!
Dang it! The Eel's been hiding out in a make-shift chamber under my lab all this time! Move in, Commander!
One of the men in your SRT was injured in the melee. But when we tried to aid him, we discovered that it was the Eel himself! He almost slipped right by us!
I've traced Sierra's tracker to a remote cave at the edge of the Empire. Move in with a task force and do try to maintain an element of surprise. The Eel can make for a formidable foe!
Ask for {total} Camouflage Hats to help you blend in with your surroundings.
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle when you fight the Eel and his men.
Daha etkili savaşmak için savaşta Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
Birlikleri Casusluk Karargâhından klonlayabilirsiniz. Henüz inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Sierra's tracker indicates that she's being held in a remote cave. Be cautious, Commander.
Argh! Sierra accidentally alerted the Eel of our position when she recognized the tracker signal! Still, you managed to put up a brave fight, Commander. The Eel is in our custody!
Oh no, it looks like Sierra isn't going to make things easy. I really wish that I had taken the time to fix this peevish streak of hers. You ought to find a way to make her cooperate!
Ask for {total} Robot Snacks to get Sierra to cooperate so that you can get her back to Seabolt.
Harvest {total} Red Onions because, who knows? Maybe robots like them!
Plant Red Onions in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
Deploy {total} Artillery Units. We can't afford to let our guard down.
Placing Artillery Units in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Barracks.
My sullen robot doesn't seem to want to cooperate with her rescuers!
Commander, no! Behind you! While you were busy with Sierra, the Eel overpowered the man who was guarding him and escaped!
Smoke everywhere! The Eel has dropped some smoke grenades around you. He's also got reinforcements emerging from the smoke. Don't let them overwhelm you, Commander!
Ask for {total} Anti-Slip Gloves. The Eel is one slippery character!
Win {total} World Domination battles. Get the Eel's men where it hurts!
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Pick your units wisely in the fight. The "Fight" button will take you to the battle.
With his smoke bombs and reinforcements, the Eel's unpredictably resourceful. Don't let him get away!
That was a valiant effort, Commander! The Eel may have managed to escape our clutches but Sierra is safe! Let's see if I can give her an attitude makeover... she could certainly use one!

Sierra has a unique tracking ID embedded inside her. I've traced her location to a fortress atop a cliff. However, we have no idea what we're facing there. Take care, Commander. Those watchtowers don't look welcoming.
Collect {total} GPS Tracking Devices to help you home in on Sierra's location.
Ask friends for GPS Tracking Devices.
Gather {total} Wood to fashion ladders in case we need to do some impromptu wall-scaling.
Kereste, Kereste Fabrikalarınızda üretilebilir ya da Ağaçlar temizlenerek elde edilebilir.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode. It looks like the watchtower guards have sighted us!
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
Sierra's tracking ID points to an isolated fortress at the top of a cliff. Be cautious, we're going in blind.
Ah, our position was compromised, but you handled those watchtower guards like a pro, Commander! They barely had the time to alert the fortress of our presence.

I think the Eel discovered Sierra's tracker because her signal just died. I can point you to the spot she was last in. It looks like a tiny lab at the heart of this maze-like fortress. Be warned, the enemy is now fully aware of your presence!
Collect {total} Bullpup Guns to keep the enemy forces at bay.
Fight the guards at the inner gate of the Eel's fortress.
Pick your units wisely in the fight. The "Fight" button will take you to the battle.
Destroy {total} enemy units as you advance through the fortress.
Units can be destroyed in battles, including Survival Mode, World Domination and Battle Blitz.
Sierra's signal stopped in the middle of the labyrinth. Stay alert, the enemy knows you're here.
Commander! One of your men reported seeing a familiar figure darting behind a huge metal door - it's the Eel! Quick, after him!

Oh no, it's a trap! That door shut behind you before you could say, "slippery when wet." I can see a deactivated Sierra in the corner but I'm a little more concerned about this small, but lethal robot army bearing down on us.
Ask for {total} Decoy Drones to distract the robots while you fight them.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights. Unleash your rage against the machines!
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle to give you an edge over the robots.
Daha etkili savaşmak için savaşta Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
It was a trap! Sierra's here, but so is a robot army just waiting to tear us to pieces!
For a while there, I thought we were done. That was most impressive, Commander! I wonder where the Eel was through all of this...
I saw Sierra lying disabled in the chamber we just passed but she seems safe for now. We still have the Eel in our sights! He just slid through that passage. Follow him!
Ask for {total} Knock Out Gas Grenades to help you fight the Eel.
Ask friends for Knock Out Gas Grenades.
Harvest {total} Wheat to keep your strength up.
Çiftliklerinize Buğday ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
Birlikleri Casusluk Karargâhından klonlayabilirsiniz. Henüz inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Sierra's safe but the Eel's on the run. After him, Commander!
So close! You almost had him cornered there. Wait, what's that sound... do you hear that?

This is bad, Commander. The Eel has triggered something that's making the fortress crumble around us! Help me reactivate Sierra. She'll help us navigate our way out of this ridiculous labyrinth! We'll worry about the Eel later.
Ask for {total} A.I. Microchips to help Seabolt reanimate Sierra.
Win {total} World Domination battles against the last of the Eel's men as you make your escape.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Deploy {total} good ol' Grunt Soldiers in your frontline to clear your path.
Placing Grunt Soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Barracks I.
The fortress is crumbling! We must reactivate Sierra. She'll know how to get us out of this place alive.
There's nothing like the reluctant help of a sullen robot in moments of dire peril! Bravo, Commander! The Eel may have gotten away this time, but Sierra's back home safe, and as cranky as ever.
The mercenaries who broke into my prison have informed me of their demands: a plane to get them out of the country and 12 million dollars' in gold. We have little time to waste.
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the Sea Dragon Submarine and SpecOps Arien Bomber; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Chaos reigns in Steele's prison. Mercenaries and prisoners have overthrown the guards and taken over.
Mercenaries have broken into my high security prison and taken over! The guards are being held captive in the cells and the convicts hold sway over the facility. I need your help, Commander.
Commander, we need to buy some time. Send out a strike team in the guise of negotiators and gain intelligence about the situation. Pretending to give into their demands might buy a few hours.
Ask for {total} Bulletproof Vests for your task force.
Collect from {total} Houses. The mercenaries must think you're taking their request seriously.
Click on Houses in your Empire, to collect.
Collect {total} Red Hearts to maintain an appearance of goodwill.
Komşularınızı ziyaret edip onlara yardım edin veya Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarındaki istilaları püskürtün.
We need to gain intelligence on this situation. Time is of the essence.
Our mission was successful, Commander. Your men brought back some interesting information. I have a feeling we'll be able to strike at their weakest point!
Let's get down to business! The information your team picked up will help us tunnel our way right into the prison cellar. We have the upper hand now. Let's strike before they know what we're about!
Collect {total} Prison Building Plans to accurately find your way into the cellar.
Ask Friend for Prison Building Plans.
Build a Strike Team as a standby in case you need backup.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Harvest {total} Corn for sustenance before you move out.
Çiftliklerinize Mısır ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
Surprise attacks are my favorite kind! Let's make our way into the prison cellars and attack from within.
Shh! We can't be too loud or our position will be compromised. Excellent work! We got in without a hitch. The fun's only just beginning!
This is it. Get your men to take up strategic hidden positions around the building. I have it on good authority that neither the prisoners nor the mercenaries know of our presence yet.
Collect {total} Micro Communication Devices to make sure your men don't lose contact.
Ask friends for Micro Communication Devices.
Deploy {total} Land Units outside the prison in case things go awry.
Placing Land Units in your Empire is deployment. Land Units are built in your Barracks.
Build {total} Power-Ups to give you an extra edge.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
Set up your men in strategic positions around the building. You have the time; we haven't set off any alarms yet.
All units in place? Let the showdown begin!
Now that we're inside, I'd say it's time for a little chaos. This is rogue prison is due for a teary surprise! Release tear gas shells into the building from your position in the cellar.
Ask for {total} Gas Masks to keep your men from feeling the effects of the gas.
Clone a Unit to standby as backup when you make your move.
Birlikleri Casusluk Karargâhından klonlayabilirsiniz. Henüz inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Complete {total} Waves of Survival Mode to prepare for battle.
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
That was impressive! You certainly know how to be an agent of chaos!
It's D-Day, Commander! Storm the prison from within and shoot on sight. Aim to slow down though, not kill. We want no blood on our hands.
Ask for {total} Sharp Shooters. They have an incredible accuracy rate.
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle as a not-so-subtle warning to your foes.
Daha etkili savaşmak için savaşta Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
Win {total} World Domination Battles. Show those mercenaries you're not to be trifled with!
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
The time has come. Hit them where it hurts!
Excellent! This is why you're the Commander, Commander!
Grab that broom there, it's cleanup time! Round up the convicts and put them back in their cells after releasing the security guards. As for the mercenaries, we're sending them to trial.
Ask for {total} Military Grade Lassos to round up the convicts.
Ask friends for Military Grade Lassos.
Clone {total} Units using the spy, Smithies.
Birlikleri Casusluk Karargâhından klonlayabilirsiniz. Henüz inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Harvest {total} Wheat. Even prisoners need nourishment.
Çiftliklerinize Buğday ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
We've got a right mess here. I'm gonna need your help cleaning up.
Here's to a job well done! Thanks for the help, Commander. I'll be sure to tighten the security at this prison. This was fun, but I'd rather not do it again!

I've decided to offer the mercenaries a plane, but no pilot. They can fly themselves. Now I know you don't agree, but you must trust me on this, Commander. Those guys are a volatile bunch. I'd rather deal with them away from my citizens.
Collect {total} Trust Exercises to help you quell your doubts and trust Steele's judgment.
Build {total} Air Units for the mercenaries.
Air Units can be built in your Hanger.
Produce it in your Super Ore Mine, or collect from Neighbors' Mines, or pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
Give them what they want, Commander. And don't worry; I have a plan to follow this up with.
Part one of their demands has been met. Now, on to part two. I'm glad you're with me on this.
I told you I had a plan. We're going to mark the gold so that you can track it later. If anyone tries to sell a single brick, we'll be on them in a flash. Wealth is nothing if you can't use it.
Collect {total} Gold Fingerprinting Systems to mark the gold.
Ask Friends for Gold Fingerprinting Systems.
Pillage {total} times. These are desperate times.
Collect from {total} Government Structures to raise the rest of the gold.
Toplamak için İmparatorluğunuzdaki Devlet Binalarına tıklayın.
Traceable gold. I do believe this is my best idea yet!
There we go. Their demands have been met. Now, we wait for them to move.

Our next step is to figure out the destination of the convicts and mercenaries and cut a deal with the leader of that country. A portion of the gold in return for their help to catch the criminals, perhaps?
Ask for {total} Diplomatic Visas to enter the country.
Build {total} Strike Teams to accompany you there.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Deploy {total} Carriers to transport your forces.
Placing Carriers in your Empire is deployment. They are built in your Shipyard.
Once we know the destination of the jail breakers, we can strike a deal with the leader of that country.
Everything's in place, Commander. Now, we wait for our quarry to arrive.

I've called in a favor from the neighboring nation where the convicts are destined to land. They're allowing us to send a highly trained squad disguised as runway marshallers to ambush them at the airport.
Ask for {total} Runway Marshaller Vests for your squad.
Ask friends for Runway Marshaller Vests.
Deploy {total} Strike Teams along with the squad.
İmparatorluğunuza yapılan istilaları püskürtürken Vurucu Tim gönderin. Onları Vurucu Tim Karargâhında kurun.
Win {total} World Domination battles in preparation for the imminent showdown.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Intercept the convicts at your neighboring Empire's airport. Their ground crew is expecting your men.
Everything's in place, Commander. Look, I think I see the plane. Here they come!
This is it, Commander. They've cottoned on to the ambush. It's time to bring in the big guns and finish this once and for all!
Ask for {total} Armored Transports to carry the captured convicts back to the prison.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights and bring the convicts down.
Harvest {total} Pineapples to celebrate a sweet victory.
Çiftliklerinize Ananas ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümelerini bekleyin.
The trap was set and our quarry is in sight. Get those guns blazing; it's time to finish this thing!
Always a pleasure working with you, Commander. My prison cells have a few more occupants thanks to you!
Those pages are extremely valuable, Commander. Without them, I won't be able to complete my new Titan design. We can't afford to let them fall into the wrong hands!

The higher your game level, the better your reward! Players at levels 12 - 30 get the SpecOps Sombrero Carrier I; levels 31 - 50 get the SpecOps Sombrero Carrier II and levels 51+ get the SpecOps Sombrero Carrier III.
Without the missing plans, Seabolt's new Titan will never be finished. Help him recover them.
Commander, we have a problem! Some vital pages from the new Titan plans I've been drawing up are missing! We must recover them.
This is going to be uncomfortable. I hate to accuse anyone, but the plans went missing when {playerA,name} visited our Empire. Let's investigate.
string.variation: This is going to be uncomfortable. I hate to accuse anyone, but the plans went missing when {playerA,fem} visited our Empire. Let's investigate.
This is going to be uncomfortable. I hate to accuse anyone, but the plans went missing when {playerA,masc} visited our Empire. Let's investigate.

string.original: Get {total} Satellite Spy Photos of the suspect's Empire.
Ask Friend for Satellite Spy Photos.
Collect {total} Red Hearts to avoid arousing suspicion.
Komşularınızı ziyaret edip onlara yardım edin veya Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarındaki istilaları püskürtün.
Clear {total} Trees from neighboring Empires and listen for rumors.
Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarını ziyaret edin ve temizlemek için Ağaçlara tıklayın.
I have a feeling one of your neighbors is behind this.
Well done, but we still don't have much to go on. We're going to have to question {playerA,name}.
string.variation: Well done, but we still don't have much to go on. We're going to have to question {playerA,fem}.
Well done, but we still don't have much to go on. We're going to have to question {playerA,masc}.

string.original: It appears that {playerA,name} has learned of our investigation and has gone into hiding. Send out a search party, Commander. We need to find answers!
string.variation: It appears that {playerA,fem} has learned of our investigation and has gone into hiding. Send out a search party, Commander. We need to find answers!
It appears that {playerA,masc} has learned of our investigation and has gone into hiding. Send out a search party, Commander. We need to find answers!

string.original: Ask for {total} Rope Ladders to scale walls if you must.
Gather {total} {nrare} to bribe people for information.
Collect from your own Mines, harvest or pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
{playerA,name} is on to our game. This won't do.
string.variation: {playerA,fem} is on to our game. This won't do.
{playerA,masc} is on to our game. This won't do.

string.original: Good job, we found {playerA,name} holed up in a shady inn. Now, let's see if we can get some clarity on this whole thing.
string.variation: Good job, we found {playerA,fem} holed up in a shady inn. Now, let's see if we can get some clarity on this whole thing.
Good job, we found {playerA,masc} holed up in a shady inn. Now, let's see if we can get some clarity on this whole thing.

string.original: {playerA,name} is in our custody. It's time we got some answers. We must tackle this delicately, Commander. Our relationship with our allies is at stake.
string.variation: {playerA,fem} is in our custody. It's time we got some answers. We must tackle this delicately, Commander. Our relationship with our allies is at stake.
{playerA,masc} is in our custody. It's time we got some answers. We must tackle this delicately, Commander. Our relationship with our allies is at stake.

string.original: Earn {total} Black Hearts as a sign that you don't like being taken for a fool.
Başarıyla istila edip istila edilen Komşulardan toplayarak veya İmparatorluğunuzdaki istilaları püskürterek Kara Yürek kazanın.
Build {total} Power-Ups to scare the truth out of {playerA,name}.
string.variation: Build {total} Power-Ups to scare the truth out of {playerA,fem}.
Build {total} Power-Ups to scare the truth out of {playerA,masc}.

string.original: Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
Tread with caution, Commander. Our questions must be answered.
Blackmail always makes things interesting. It appears that Dirk Mollman is holding {playerA,name}'s family hostage and will release them only once he has the Titan plans in hand.
string.variation: Blackmail always makes things interesting. It appears that Dirk Mollman is holding {playerA,fem}'s family hostage and will release them only once he has the Titan plans in hand.
Blackmail always makes things interesting. It appears that Dirk Mollman is holding {playerA,masc}'s family hostage and will release them only once he has the Titan plans in hand.

string.original: {playerA,name} has pointed us to where Dirk's Titans are holding the hostages. This isn't going to be easy. It's vital that you get them out safely!
string.variation: {playerA,fem} has pointed us to where Dirk's Titans are holding the hostages. This isn't going to be easy. It's vital that you get them out safely!
{playerA,masc} has pointed us to where Dirk's Titans are holding the hostages. This isn't going to be easy. It's vital that you get them out safely!

string.original: Ask for {total} Candy Bars to soothe hostages. Chocolate makes everything better.
Fight the Titans holding {playerA,name}'s family hostage.
string.variation: Fight the Titans holding {playerA,fem}'s family hostage.
Fight the Titans holding {playerA,masc}'s family hostage.

string.original: Savaşta birliklerinizi akıllıca seçin. Kendi Titanlarınızı kullanmak size üstünlük sağlar.
Deploy a Strike Team to assist you.
İmparatorluğunuza yapılan istilaları püskürtürken Vurucu Tim gönderin. Onları Vurucu Tim Karargâhında kurun.
Thanks to {playerA,name}, we now know where to find the hostages.
string.variation: Thanks to {playerA,fem}, we now know where to find the hostages.
Thanks to {playerA,masc}, we now know where to find the hostages.

string.original: Excellent! {playerA,name}'s family is safe and sound. You made sure that no harm came to them. But I'm afraid that in the chaos of it all, Dirk escaped with the plans!
string.variation: Excellent! {playerA,fem}'s family is safe and sound. You made sure that no harm came to them. But I'm afraid that in the chaos of it all, Dirk escaped with the plans!
Excellent! {playerA,masc}'s family is safe and sound. You made sure that no harm came to them. But I'm afraid that in the chaos of it all, Dirk escaped with the plans!

string.original: One of the hostages overheard Dirk say he was going to sell the plans to B.F. Dealio. We've dealt with Dealio in the past. A little intimidation will go a long way in getting information out of him.
Collect {total} Brass Knuckles to intimidate Dealio with.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights as a sign of your superior strength.
Harvest {total} Red Onions with which to make Dealio cry.
Plant Red Onions in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
It's time to play the 'bad cop' card!
Dealio claims that Dirk tried to sell him the plans, but he wanted much more than what Dealio was offering.

According to Dealio, Dirk knows he can't safely sell the plans anywhere else without arousing our suspicions. He's planning to lie low for a while in his most recent underground lair. Get ready, Commander. We're going under.
Collect {total} Trained Moles to be our eyes underground.
Build {total} Strike Teams to help you hunt for Dirk's lair.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Dirk loves his tunnel hideouts. Lucky for us, we've got some friendly helpers underground.
Great work! I knew you'd find Dirk's hidey-hole in record time.

We've found the tunnel entrance to Dirk's lair but I don't think we should go down there. Dirk is notorious for his booby traps and we're not familiar with the tunnels. I say we draw him above ground.
Collect {total} Smoke Bombs to smoke Dirk out of his lair.
Win {total} World Domination fights to keep your skills sharp.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Clone {total} Units in case you need backup.
Birlikleri Casusluk Karargâhından klonlayabilirsiniz. Henüz inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
It's time to draw the Mollman out of his hole!
Here he comes! Quick, let's get him before he tries to escape!
Now that he's above ground, Dirk doesn't have an advantage over us. Bring him down, but steer clear of his drill. He isn't picky about where he sticks it!
Collect {total} Shipping Tubes to carry the plans safely back.
Fight the Titans who try to keep you from Dirk.
Using Titans of your own will give you an edge in battle.
Fight the last of Dirk's forces.
Get that thieving rat, Commander. Just watch out for his drill. That thing can get nasty!
We did it! Dirk has had quite a lesson drilled into him and I've got my precious plans back. I owe you one, Commander!
We don't know who the Duchess is after, nor how or when she plans to attack. Let's rally our resources and stop her!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Bull Tank and SpecOps Anitron Fighter; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
The Duchess is back and plotting an assassination. Don't let her succeed!
Commander, one of my spies has uncovered some disturbing information. It appears that the Duchess is plotting a major assassination in your Empire!
The intel I received was encrypted and I only managed to decipher the first bit. We need to break the code and find out who the Duchess' target is.
Ask for {total} Code Breakers to decode the encrypted message.
Pay the Code Breakers {total} Coins. It's an expensive service they offer.
Harcanan Para kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek Paranız olduğundan emin olun.
Clear {total} Trees from your neighbors' Empires. Find out if they know anything.
Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarını ziyaret edin ve temizlemek için Ağaçlara tıklayın.
Get your best Code Breakers on the job. This is one of the toughest I've seen!
It's lucky that we discovered this plot now, Commander. Things would have taken a disastrous turn if we hadn't!
The decoded message says that the Duchess' target is none other than Scarlett! We had better tighten our security. We should also set up Scarlett with some personal body guards.
Collect {total} Armed Body Guards for Scarlett's protection.
Ask Friend for Armed Body Guards.
Gather {total} Wood to strengthen your stronghold.
Kereste, Kereste Fabrikalarınızda üretilebilir ya da Ağaçlar temizlenerek elde edilebilir.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Personal space is going to be just a dream for Scarlett until this is over!
Oh no! I've just received word that the Duchess had fed my spy false information. The real target is actually one of our allies! I hope we're not too late!
We must race to warn {playerA,name} but I'm afraid the Duchess may beat us to it. Look, Commander! There she is!
string.variation: We must race to warn {playerA,fem} but I'm afraid the Duchess may beat us to it. Look, Commander! There she is!
We must race to warn {playerA,masc} but I'm afraid the Duchess may beat us to it. Look, Commander! There she is!

string.original: Collect {total} Carrier Pigeons to send a warning to {playerA,name}.
string.variation: Collect {total} Carrier Pigeons to send a warning to {playerA,fem}.
Collect {total} Carrier Pigeons to send a warning to {playerA,masc}.

string.original: Use the Experimental healing ability {total} times in battle to prepare you to face the Duchess.
The Medivac Chopper, Hospital Ship and Army Ambulance offer these healing abilities.
Deploy {total} Infantry units to back you up.
Placing Infantry Units in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
This mistake could prove fatal to {playerA,name} if we're too late.
string.variation: This mistake could prove fatal to {playerA,fem} if we're too late.
This mistake could prove fatal to {playerA,masc} if we're too late.

string.original: We got lucky, Commander! We got here just in time to distract the Duchess. Her aim was ever so slightly off. {playerA,name} is injured, but alive thanks to you!
string.variation: We got lucky, Commander! We got here just in time to distract the Duchess. Her aim was ever so slightly off. {playerA,fem} is injured, but alive thanks to you!
We got lucky, Commander! We got here just in time to distract the Duchess. Her aim was ever so slightly off. {playerA,masc} is injured, but alive thanks to you!

string.original: The Duchess has rigged {playerA,name}'s car with a car bomb. Assemble a bomb squad. If we hurry, we might save the car!
string.variation: The Duchess has rigged {playerA,fem}'s car with a car bomb. Assemble a bomb squad. If we hurry, we might save the car!
The Duchess has rigged {playerA,masc}'s car with a car bomb. Assemble a bomb squad. If we hurry, we might save the car!

string.original: Ask for {total} Bomb Disposal Suits for the bomb squad.
Ask friends for Bomb Disposal Suits.
Gather {total} {nrare2}. The bomb squad needs the resources.
Bu cevher Süper Cevher Madeninizde üretilebilir, Komşulardan hasat edilip yağmalanabilir ya da savaşta kazanılabilir.
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode to prepare you to meet the Duchess.
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
Hurry, we can't let {playerA,name} get into that car!
string.variation: Hurry, we can't let {playerA,fem} get into that car!
Hurry, we can't let {playerA,masc} get into that car!

string.original: That was some explosion! We didn't make it in time, but the bomb off prematurely. Lucky for us, {playerA,name} was a few yards away and was only stunned.
string.variation: That was some explosion! We didn't make it in time, but the bomb off prematurely. Lucky for us, {playerA,fem} was a few yards away and was only stunned.
That was some explosion! We didn't make it in time, but the bomb off prematurely. Lucky for us, {playerA,masc} was a few yards away and was only stunned.

string.original: Don't rest easy yet, Commander. The Duchess isn't one to give up without a fight. She is bound to attempt the botched assassination again. We must stop her. Let's start by blowing up her arsenal...
Ask for {total} Remote Detonators to destroy the Duchess' arsenal.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights and break through the Duchess' defenses.
Win {total} World Domination battles and bring the Duchess down.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
I've had enough of playing defense. It's time to get aggressive!
She was formidable, but you stood your ground. Well done, Commander. Victory tastes sweet indeed!

The Duchess isn't going to like the new bracelets on her wrists, but that isn't our concern. {playerA,name} is. Let's arrange for some therapy for our ally's PTSD. An assassination attempt can be traumatic...
string.variation: The Duchess isn't going to like the new bracelets on her wrists, but that isn't our concern. {playerA,fem} is. Let's arrange for some therapy for our ally's PTSD. An assassination attempt can be traumatic...

The Duchess isn't going to like the new bracelets on her wrists, but that isn't our concern. {playerA,masc} is. Let's arrange for some therapy for our ally's PTSD. An assassination attempt can be traumatic...

string.original: Ask for {total} Self-Help Audiotapes to assist in {playerA,name}'s recovery.
string.variation: Ask for {total} Self-Help Audiotapes to assist in {playerA,fem}'s recovery.
Ask for {total} Self-Help Audiotapes to assist in {playerA,masc}'s recovery.

string.original: Build {total} Mind Control Strike Teams. No one said therapy's easy.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Harvest {total} Pineapples. Pineapple jam - apparently better than anti-anxiety pills.
Çiftliklerinize Ananas ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümelerini bekleyin.
Slap those 'cuffs on her, Commander! And let's see what we can do to ease {playerA,name}'s trauma.
string.variation: Slap those 'cuffs on her, Commander! And let's see what we can do to ease {playerA,fem}'s trauma.
Slap those 'cuffs on her, Commander! And let's see what we can do to ease {playerA,masc}'s trauma.

string.original: And it's done! The Duchess is safely in our custody and {playerA,name} is on the fast road to recovery.
string.variation: And it's done! The Duchess is safely in our custody and {playerA,fem} is on the fast road to recovery.
And it's done! The Duchess is safely in our custody and {playerA,masc} is on the fast road to recovery.

string.original: It's as bad as we expected. You're the Duchess' target, Commander. I'd ask you to stay out of this but I think I already know your answer. For now, let's make the Empire a little safer for you.
Collect {total} Bulletproof Screens for our Government buildings.
Build an Ambush Strike Team to station around your buildings.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Gather {total} Oil to keep your units fueled and ready for action.
Collect from your own Wells or Neighbors' Wells, pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
This is a disturbing development but you can't let it slow you down. Our first step is to set up the necessary safety measures.
Good work! We've taken a lot of precautions to make the Empire as safe as possible but there's no telling where the Duchess will break through our defenses.

With the Duchess, the only way to get the upper hand is to find her before she comes for us. I bet we can trace her location if we do some credit card checks. The Duchess is known to be a little credit-happy.
Collect{total} Credit Trackers to monitor the Duchess' credit activity.
Revive your neighbors' Crops {total} times. They'll be happy to help you when you need it.
Click on withered Crops in your Neighbors' Empires to revive them.
Pillage {total} times to keep your battle skills sharp.
The Duchess can't resist the lure of that shiny piece of plastic!
I knew that would work! Sure enough, a slew of credit purchases led us straight to her.

Since you're her target, it's a good idea to take some extra precautions. Set yourself up with a host of decoy dummies around you in addition to your personal guard.The Duchess won't be able to get a clear shot!
Ask for {total} Decoy Dummies to surround yourself with.
Clone {total} Units using the spy, Smithies. Ready backup can be a lifesaver.
Birlikleri Casusluk Karargâhından klonlayabilirsiniz. Henüz inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Collect {total} Element Z. It's sure to come in handy.
Element Z hasat etmek için Element Z Çarpıştırıcısı ya da Element Z Rafinerisi inşa edin. Bu kaynağı arkadaşlarınızdan hediye olarak da alabilirsiniz.
Keep yourself surrounded at all times, Commander. If you don't have enough men, we can fix that.
Excellent! I'd like to see the Duchess try and make that shot now!

I know the arms dealer who supplies the Duchess; he isn't the most morally upright citizen. I also know that he has a thing for antiques. We can bribe him to replace the bullets he sells her with blanks.
Ask for {total} Antique Weapons to bribe the dealer with.
Offer {total} Oil to the arms dealer.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Use the Experimental Area Barrage ability {total} times in battle to intimidate the arms dealer.
The Cold War Interceptor, Barrage Truck and Sea Shadow offer this ability.
You're not above a little bribery, are you?
That was smooth, Commander! You really know how to play the bribery game. I don't know whether to be impressed or worried.
I've been hit! The Duchess caught on to us and took a cheap shot at me in a fit of fury. But it's only a flesh wound...It's up to you now. Bring her down!
Ask for {total} First Aid Kits to tend Steele's wound.
Ask friends for First Aid Kits.
You can use any Units when fighting Land Units.
Fight the Duchess and her forces.
Ugh, women! So fickle. Just when you think she's coming for you...
You did it! That was some defeat, Commander. Her anger made her reckless... I knew I didn't get shot for nothing!
We must hurry and set up our mining rig over the mineral deposit. I have a feeling we're not the only ones trying to make the most of this resource!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Oton Battleship and SpecOps Armen Copter; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Our deep sea mining rig is under a Dark Alliance threat!
Commander, There's a seam of rare earth minerals at the bottom of the sea, a few miles off the coast of our Empire. This could be a very valuable resource for us. Let's get mining!

Our first job is to pinpoint the exact location of this mineral deposit. Once we're sure of the spot, we can start making preparations to set up a deep sea mining rig. We'll be mining minerals in no time!
Ask for {total} Sea Cranes to set up the rig.
Clear {total} Trees in neighboring Empires. Wood is necessary for building.
Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarını ziyaret edin ve temizlemek için Ağaçlara tıklayın.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
My information didn't come with a handy 'X' to mark the spot. Find it so that we can set up!
All set, Commander? Let's head out to sea!

I knew it couldn't be this easy. We've got problems, Commander. It looks like Captain Krunsch beat us to it! He's setting up a rig of his own. These are technically still our waters so let's get him out!
Collect {total} Grappling Hooks to climb onto Krunsch's ship.
Invade one of your neighbors... we suspect that they're aiding Krunsch.
Find this Ally on your Neighbor Bar.
Krunsch and his ships are encroaching on our mineral deposit! Kick 'em out of there!
Krunsch sure beat a hasty retreat! It was almost suspicious, but we'll take our victories where we get them.
Krunsch may have retreated, but I know that he's just rallying his resources to strike again. In the meantime, that fight led to an oil spill that simply must be cleaned up!
Collect {total} Oil Skimmers to clean up the oil spill.
Deploy {total} Gunboats to patrol the area while you work.
Placing Gunboats in your Empire is deployment. They are built in your Shipyard.
Build {total} Power-Ups to boost your progress.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
Somebody was careless during that last fight. Let's clean up this oily mess.
Good job. We're on shaky ground with this deep sea mining process as it is. We must be responsible for all the environmental repercussions.

I can see why Krunsch retreated in such a hurry. The skies have opened up... there's a storm upon us, Commander! And it looks like a bad one. We won't make it back to our Empire in time. We'll just have to weather it as best as we can.
Ask for {total} Drift Anchors to secure your Ships.
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode. Stand your ground against the elements!
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
Expand your Naval Depot once. You'll soon be grateful for the extra space.
Geliştirme, Depoya daha fazla yer eklemenizi sağlar.
Hold fast, Commander. We're facing rough seas!
You did it! It was touch and go for a bit there, but the skies have cleared now. Let's get back to business.

Now that everything's clear, let's head down to the rare earth mineral deposit. Be warned, Commander, there are other dangers that lurk in the deep! I have heard dreadful stories of a giant squid in these waters...
Ask for {total} Giant Squid Repellents to keep us safe below.
Ask Friends for Giant Squid Repellents.
Deploy {total} Battleships in case Krunsch shows up again.
Placing Battleships in your Empire is deployment. They are built in your Shipyard.
Fend off the monsters of the sea!
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
The depths are dark and full of terrors.
Do you know, I actually believed we wouldn't even catch a glimpse of the squid! You were brave down there, but that clash has exhausted your oxygen supply. Replenish and start again.
It's time to finish setting up our rig on the seabed. We lost some valuable time though... Krunsch's divers have returned.
Ask for {total} Air Compressors to replenish your dive tanks.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights and defeat all the divers.
Win {total} Domination battles. Show the Captain who's boss!
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
We have some unwelcome company again.
Nicely done! Krunsch would have to be clinically unbalanced to try and steal a piece of this mineral deposit again.
Mobilize your divers and send them down to oversee the installation of our deep sea mining rig on the seabed.
Collect {total} Dive Permits so that you can navigate the deep.
Use {total} Oil to power the boats that carry your divers out to sea.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Build {total} Sea Units to maintain steady traffic to and from the rig.
Sea Units can be built in your Shipyards.
Divers make for really good scouts.
Good work Commander. Now we sit back and wait for news from our divers.

Our divers returned to report that some Dark Alliance divers were already at the mineral seam. It looked like Captain Krunsch's work. This will be easier if we work with him. Make a deal with him to share resources.
Collect {total} Cabin Boys to share the workload on both rigs.
Earn {total} Red Hearts to seal the deal.
Komşularınızı ziyaret edip onlara yardım edin veya Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarındaki istilaları püskürtün.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
The Captain could make things very difficult for us. Let's see if we can work with him instead.
This seems to be going well. Play nice together now!
Krunsch's men double crossed us! They stole our diving equipment and made their way down to the ocean floor to dismantle our rig. Follow them down!
Ask for {total} Diving Helmets to replace the ones you lost.
Pillage {total} times to show that you mean business.
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
I should have seen this one coming. Apologies, Commander. You're going to have to fix this.
Krunsch's men had an unfair advantage over us. Worry not, Commander. Reinforcements are on their way.
I have bad news... A freak accident led to a misunderstanding between your men and Krunsch's. They think we've double crossed them. Defend yourself, quick!
Ask for {total} Work Logs to prove the accident wasn't your fault.
Use {total} Power-Ups to give you an edge.
Daha etkili savaşmak için savaşta Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
I half suspect that Krunsch was looking for an excuse to throw this deal.
You won this round... but this is far from over.
Krunsch intends to claim sole custody of the resources mined from that deposit. It's time to wipe the area of all trace of him. I've had enough of his shenanigans!
Ask for {total} Cannon Ramrods to load the cannons and sink Krunsch's ships.
Win {total} Domination Battles and put an end to Krunsch's mischief.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Add {total} Allies to help you defeat Captain Krunsch.
Add more neighbors through your Neighbor Bar. Neighbors will help you progress faster!
Let's send the good Captain down with his ship. Although, knowing Krunsch, he'll abandon ship long before it sinks.
You did good, Commander! Those resources are now ours to mine freely.
We must find a way to put an end to Soren's tyranny, Commander, and not just for the sake of the people of Vonne. As long as Soren rules, all the Empires will face a very real threat of war.

The higher your game level, the better your reward! Players at levels 12 - 30 get the SpecOps Anubis Infantry I; levels 31 - 50 get the SpecOps Anubis Infantry II and levels 51+ get the SpecOps Anubis Infantry III.
A dictator raises his ugly head. Put an end to the tyranny!
War is brewing in the country of Vonne and its dictator, Soren, is at the heart of it all. This situation is more volatile that we previously thought. We must take drastic measures to control it.
Our best men are away on an important mission with Steele. I suggest that you assemble a new squad with the men we have at hand. Start training them, Commander.
Get {total} Bootcamp Cadences to get your men into their rhythm faster.
Use {total} Oil to get some rusty rifles ready for the training exercises.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Pick your units wisely in this fight.
You'll just have to make do, Commander. You can't always have the best.
Oh no, with our best men gone; this squad doesn't have a hope of acquiring the level of skill we need to take Soren down.
Now, hear me out, Commander. As one of the best hit squads around, the Graves girls may be just what we need to whip our team into shape on short notice... for a price, of course.
Ask for {total} Lawyers to draw up a legal contract with the girls.
Give {total} Coins to the girls as part of a down payment for their services.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Complete an upgrade for your Army Depot. You'll need the space for your new units.
Geliştirme, Depoya daha fazla yer eklemenizi sağlar.
Legal counsel is always handy when dealing with the Graves girls.
Hmm, only Gina Graves accepted our deal. Tina is apparently away "on a job." But it matters not. Gina should do just fine.

It seems that Gina has been having a little too much fun with our men. All her toying and flirting has caused some rifts among them. Knock some sense into them, Commander. And make sure Gina gets her act together.
Collect {total} Disciplinary Rulers. Your men are behaving like children.
Deploy {total} Soldiers to make sure the squad gets back in line.
Placing soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode with your men.
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
Honestly, why are you even surprised? I knew Gina would pull something like this. She IS a Graves!
It's a good thing you managed to straighten out your squad, Commander. we don't have all the time in the world to get this job done.
Good news! It looks like this rag-tag bunch of men might actually be ready for their mission! Help Gina put them through one last training exercise to see if I'm right.
Ask for {total} Shooting Targets for the training exercise.
Deal {total} damage using Infantry Units and sharpen your squad's skills.
Use Infantry Units to fight battles and deal damage. Infantry Units can be built in your Barracks.
