Pick your units wisely in this fight.
It's time to see if Gina managed to do more than just tease your men.
Yes! Gina did it! You know, I hate to admit it, but I'm impressed with her work. She did a darned good job of whipping our men into shape. They're as ready as they'll ever be.
Let's get this operation on the road, Commander. We attack Soren's mansion before dawn.
Collect {total} Mission Maps for your squad.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights. Things are starting to heat up!
Spend {total} Coins to get this mission started.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Your men are a tad overenthusiastic. Order them to move quietly!
Our men were ambushed! Soren was expecting them; we only just got out in time. But here's what's interesting... one of them spotted Gina lounging in Soren's office!

It just had to be too easy! Knowing the girls as we do, I'm pretty sure it was Tina Graves that our man spotted. They must have been in contact this entire time! Maybe they hoped for a double payout? This complicates things.
Collect {total} Connection Charts to plot out all the possible obstacles we could now face.
Build {total} Mind Control Strike Teams to get into the Graves girls' heads.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
Build {total} Power-Ups to prepare for an imminent battle.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
I should have known. You can never trust a Graves!
Gina's betrayal was a huge spanner in the works but I think we can still salvage this mission. Those girls are due for a spanking!

We have a better chance of defeating the girls if we take them down one at a time. Gina doesn't yet know that we spotted Tina and figured out their game. She'll be back to collect her training fee. Let's set up a little welcome for her.
Collect {total} Booby Traps to set out for Gina.
Bu cevher Süper Cevher Madeninizde üretilebilir, Komşulardan hasat edilip yağmalanabilir ya da savaşta kazanılabilir.
Deal {total} damage to Land Units to make Gina think we're just preparing for round 2.
Stronger Units will deal greater damage in battle.
She doesn't know that we know what she knows. You know?
Good work, Commander! We've got the first Graves!

It's time for a face-off with Gina's crazy twin. This time, I'm coming with you. I've used a cast of Gina's face to get some latex masks fashioned. If Tina's expecting her sister at Soren's mansion, we can't disappoint her! Let's get two birds with this stone.
Collect {total} Mask Sculptors to make masks of Gina's face for our disguise.
Deal {total} damage using Air Units. We're going in from the skies!
Use Air Units to fight battles and deal damage. Air Units can be built in your Hangar.
Win {total} World Domination fights. Time to bring Tina and Soren down!
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
You don't have to be stingy with your units; this is a Graves girl after all.
Success! I must say, impersonating a Graves girl was way more fun than I thought it would be! Tina's in our custody and so is Soren. Excellent work, Commander!
More difficult levels will grant you greater rewards. Choose wisely because you won't be able to change this level once you start.

If you think we're horsing around, think again! When a prince, who always gets his way, finds his champion horse missing and you're hosting the race it was to win, it could mean war! With no ransom note, we have no idea what's involved!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Behemoth Artillery and SpecOps Ankit UUV Patrol Boat; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Find a missing champion horse in time for the International Cup! Before the prince who owns it becomes a royal pain!
The cup favorite for the multi-nation derby we're hosting is gone! The angry owner is a spoilt prince! He's threatening to do some serious damage if we don't find his horse.
You earned 5x SpecOps Ankit UUV Patrol Boat!

We're facing accusations of sabotaging the race! Get an investigative team together. Brief them and impress on them the consequences of not finding the horse, Silver Bullet. His owner is turning up the heat!
Ask for {total} Disposable Cellphones to keep your team connected.
Donate {total} Wood to other horse owners to build secure pens.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Fight another minor trouble-making nation that's trying to impress the prince, by attacking you.
This is no time to horse around, Commander. Tensions are running high today!
Is your team ready? I hope they understand how serious this situation is. This isn't just any horse that's gone missing...

Before we expand our search, we have to make sure that Silver Bullet isn't stashed under our noses. Set up road blocks in a 20 mile radius around the course and check all vehicles that look large enough to hold a horse.
Collect {total} Spiked Roadblocks to set up on your streets.
Deploy {total} Land Units in case the horse's owner attacks!
Placing Land Units in your Empire is deployment. Land Units are built in your Barracks.
A radical group in the Prince's Empire saw a chance to cause havoc. Fight them and win.
One too many villains have pulled fast ones on us by hiding in plain sight. That's not going to happen this time!
All done? No kidnapped horse in sight? All right, let's expand our investigation.
Let's get our people involved! Put out news broadcasts with pictures of Silver Bullet, pictures of any suspects and a reward notice for any information.
Collect {total} Reward Posters to motivate the public to help.
Donate {total} Oil to fuel your search teams' vehicles.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Build {total} Strike Team(s) in preparation for a horse rescue mission.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
An extra mile for an extra buck. That's the way the world works!
Our phones are ringing off the hook! A lot of the calls coming in are rubbish but we've already picked up a couple of potential leads. Good work!
Our best sources of intel have often been disreputable ones. Incentivize our underworld informants. Promise to wipe their slates clean if they can give you any information on a horse being moved.
Ask for {total} Criminal Records to be wiped clean.
Donate {total} Coins to a local business owned by the Mafia.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Get {total} Element Z, as a battle resource back-up.
Element Z hasat etmek için Element Z Çarpıştırıcısı ya da Element Z Rafinerisi inşa edin. Bu kaynağı arkadaşlarınızdan hediye olarak da alabilirsiniz.
The seedy miscreants in your Empire often hold a wealth of information... if you know whom to ask!
Very smooth, Commander! One of your informants came forward with some interesting information. Let's see if it checks out!
Our source claims that the culprit is a disgruntled jockey who was banned from racing, due to charges of malpractice. I have word on where he might be hiding out. Let's head over there.
Ask for {total} Snapshots of the suspect so that your men will recognize him.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights as practice for any upcoming fights.
Fight a few goons who are protecting the culprit.
These jockeys. So quick to anger!
Our little man had a band of tough goons to protect him. Unfortunately for us, he escaped while you were fighting them.

Commander, we have sights on our runaway horse-napper! He's not very stable though. From the way he's been treating the horse, I can tell he isn't above hurting it if we get too close. Put those guns down; it's time to negotiate.
Ask for {total} Mediators to help you talk to the culprit.
Deploy {total} Grunt Soldiers because this mission is heating up.
Placing Grunt Soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
Harvest {total} Red Onions for soup. Mediators work best on full stomachs.
Plant Red Onions in your Farms and wait for them to grow before harvesting.
I'll let you in on a little secret: a little sweet-talking can break even the most hardened of criminals.
Excellent work, Commander! The jockey gave himself up in exchange for a more lenient sentence. Silver Bullet is back with his owner! Peace reigns again!

Mobilize that team you assembled. We're going to send them out in search of information. They have permission to cross borders if they have to. Tell them to be careful though. Getting caught could make things even more awkward.
Collect {total} Fake Passports for your spies in case they need them.
Build {total} Bombers in case more fighting breaks out.
Bombers can be built in your Hangar.
Gather {total} {rare} to make guns, to supply your investigators.
Collect from your own Mines, harvest or pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
I dislike resorting to underhanded methods, but these are desperate times...
As I suspected, an enemy nation had Silver Bullet kidnapped! Their plan of course was to get you in the bad books of the owner - a Prince known for his temper!
One of our spies has brought back intel about a deserted warehouse near the docks that was hired by an anonymous source. It's the perfect place to hide a stolen horse. Find the warehouse!
Collect {total} Area Images of the dock.
Build {total} Power-Ups to be better prepared.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode, to test your battle reflexes.
You don't have to complete all the waves at one go. You can come back later and try again.
The dock that the spy spoke about has several warehouses within a 5 mile radius. Scour them all!
You heard neighing? That must be it, Commander! You found the warehouse!

This is the one! Station your men around the targeted warehouse. But remember, shooting inside will certainly harm the horse. We cannot afford to let anything happen to it. You must lure the villains out instead.
Ask for {total} Flashbangs to lure the villains outside the warehouse.
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle to get an advantage.
Daha etkili savaşmak için savaşta Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
Earn {total} Black Hearts because you're not above a little distraction deception.
Başarıyla istila edip istila edilen Komşulardan toplayarak veya İmparatorluğunuzdaki istilaları püskürterek Kara Yürek kazanın.
Bright lights and loud noises - always good methods to grab attention!
It worked like a charm! Here they come... go get them, Commander!

We were too late! The warehouse was empty by the time we got there. I think the idea was to ship Silver Bullet out in a cargo container. Race to the docks and intercept them! We need to find the right container and we're running out of time.
Ask for {total} Bloodhounds to help you find the right container with the horse.
Use {total} Experimental Abilities in battle, just to show off a little.
Experimental Units can be built in the Experimental Shipyard, Experimental Barracks and Experimental Hangar. The 'Use Element Z' button below the battle stage activates this ability.
Deploy {total} Soldiers to be stationed around the docks.
Placing Soldiers in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
No container wall is too thick for a bloodhound's nose!
Excellent! You recovered the champion horse! The villains may have escaped but our primary concern is returning the horse to its owners.

The races are back on! Stay on your guard, the villains aren't about to give up just yet. Set up snipers at strategic locations around the course. The enemy is desperate, now that they've been caught. Here they come!
Ask for {total} Scout Scopes for your snipers on the watch.
Get {total} Domination War Chests to prove that you rule!
Kazandığınız her Hâkimiyet savaşında bir Savaş Sandığı alırsınız.
When thwarted, villains always come back for that final run.
You caught the villains and the Prince has withdrawn his threat of war. What's more, the races were a grand success in spite of all this drama! You did it, Commander!

The psychopath has threatened that if we lose, his game will ultimately lead us to war with Bentris, a neighboring nation. He has asked for 100 million dollars as ransom in order to abort all the disasters. We can't let this happen!
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the SpecOps Raccoon Copter and SpecOps Grimm D7 Carrier; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
Will you be just a puppet in a madman's dance of disaster?

I received an anonymous call regarding a series of disasters set to occur in our Empire. The caller said that they will begin on his command but we will be given clues an hour before each starts. It's a dangerous game...but play, we must!
You earned 5x SpecOps Grimm D7 Carrier!

Let's start with our only clue: Bentris, the nation apparently on the brink of war with us. We must know of any possibilities that could provoke this kind of trouble. Invite the nation's leader to your Empire for a diplomatic discussion.
Ask for {total} Cups of Coffee so that the suspect doesn't suspect anything.
Ask Friends for Cups of Coffee.
Take out his personal bodyguards, just to make sure they don't attack.
Earn {total} Red Hearts as a gesture of goodwill to your Neighbors.
Komşularınızı ziyaret edip onlara yardım edin veya Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarındaki istilaları püskürtün.
Coffee: the great unifier and potential spiller of secrets.
Well, you grilled him as much as you could without outright demanding answers. It looks like he really knows nothing about our mystery caller and his threats...
We have very little to go on, Commander. We must make contact. We need a time extension. Tell the madman we can't arrange for that kind of money in such a short time span.
Collect and send him {total} Bottles of Wine to soften him up to our request.
Ask Friends for Bottles of Wine.
Give {total} Wood to Real Estate tycoons for construction, so they'll help raise funds if needed.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Build a Strike Team to deal with any disaster, if the madman grants no extension.
Henüz bir Vurucu Tim Karargâhı inşa etmediyseniz, onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulabilirsiniz.
A lot can be done with an extra 24 hours.
It could just be the wine talking, but our caller has agreed to a 24-hour extension. Let's work fast!

The villain must not suspect that you're trying to track him down! I've organized several crack teams of intelligence agents to interrogate members of the underworld on the sly. Who knows what we'll be able to squeeze out of them?
Collect {total} Foldable Knives to intimidate members of the underworld.
Pillage {total} times to demonstrate that messing with you is not a good idea.
Destroy {total} Land Units as you go on your information collection rampage.
Land Units can be destroyed in battles, including Survival Mode, World Domination and Battle Blitz.
It's crazy; those underworld guys always seem to know what's going on!
Hmmm, now this is interesting...our agents have unearthed some curious information.

Let's set our police force in motion. They have their own network of confidential informants within the criminal circles. We can pull them in to find out if they've heard of anything that's going down.
Ask for {total} C.I. Phonebooks to call in the confidential informants.
Earn {total} Black Hearts to show off your superior power.
Başarıyla istila edip istila edilen Komşulardan toplayarak veya İmparatorluğunuzdaki istilaları püskürterek Kara Yürek kazanın.
Collect {total} {nrare4} because it pays to be prepared.
Bu cevher Süper Cevher Madeninizde üretilebilir, Komşulardan hasat edilip yağmalanabilir ya da savaşta kazanılabilir.
Be careful not to compromise the informants when you meet them. They need to maintain their criminal contacts to be of use.
Our informants have discovered a trail of evidence that leads to a local crime lord. This whole thing is just getting murkier the deeper we dig! Let's see if we're right...
Ask for {total} Night Vision Binoculars to help us set up an after-dark ambush.
Ask Friends for Night Vision Binoculars.
Deal {total} damage using Air Units, to sharpen your pilots' skills, just in case.
Use Air Units to fight battles and deal damage. Air Units can be built in your Hangar.
Fight the crime lord and win!
This crime lord won't be expecting us. Use the cover of the night and the element of surprise to your advantage.
This investigation has come full circle, Commander! The crime lord caved and revealed that the nation leader we first met with was behind it all along!
It's time to go straight to the heart of this mess. Use force to teach that conniving nation leader a lesson he'll never forget. The only ransom he will receive is a big dent in his armed forces!
Ask for {total} Ammo Belts to arm your troops with.
Win {total} World Domination fights as practice for the upcoming battle.
Dünya Hâkimiyeti savaşlarında insanlara saldırabilir ya da size saldıranlardan intikam alabilirsiniz.
Win {total} Battle Blitz fights to practice even more.
Our enemy is bringing out the big guns so you'd better do the same!
Impressive work, Commander! Here's to the end of this madness.

We just received our first clue, Commander. And of course, it's in the form of a riddle. I tell you, these people watch too many movies. I have a bad feeling that it relates to a bomb somewhere. Let's get cracking!
Collect {total} Cryptographers to unravel the riddle.
Harvest {total} Corn to make a meal for the hardworking investigators.
Çiftliklerinize Mısır ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
Gather {total} {rare} because metal is always a useful resource to have.
Collect from your own Mines, harvest or pillage from Neighbors, or receive in battle.
The madman fancies himself a riddler. Solve it quick! It will only spell disaster if you don't.
That was quick work, Commander! That bomb blast was very narrowly averted. Let's see what this madman's next move is.

Our 'friendly, neighborhood' psychopath didn't bank on us thwarting his first disaster. He didn't bother with his rules and riddles this time. Masked gunmen are terrorizing the area surrounding your World Embassy!
Collect {total} sets of Riot Gear for your men.
Complete {total} waves in Survival Mode to remind your men that you're great survivors!
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
Use {total} Strike Teams to handle the masked gunmen.
Deploy Strike Teams when repelling invasions in your Empire. Build them at the Strike Team HQ.
So much for the psycho's great game. Nobody plays by the rules anymore.
Your quick decisions on the field saved the World Embassy! But I fear that the hard part is only beginning...

The psychopath has made another move: this time his target is a nuclear plant in the Empire. He has taken some of the workers hostage! It's up to you to secretly infiltrate the facility and free it of his hold.
Ask for {total} NBC Suits for radiation protection.
Use {total} Power-Ups in battle, because now you need the upper hand.
Daha etkili savaşmak için savaşta Güçlendirici kullanın. Güçlendiriciler Yıldırım Savaşı ve Hâkimiyet zaferlerinden kazanılır ya da Güçlendirici Fabrikanızda üretilir.
Build {total} Soldiers to increase your force against this unseen enemy.
Soldiers can be built in your Army Barracks.
I'm not certain how you managed it, but you did it! The nuclear plant is back in our possession! Those hostages couldn't be more grateful.

The madman has struck again! The power supply across your subway lines has been cut, causing complete chaos underground! You need to restore the power and evacuate the people before panic takes over completely.
Ask for {total} Heavy Duty Generators to supply power to the subway.
Ask Friends for Heavy Duty Generators.
Harvest {total} Element Z as a back-up war resource.
Element Z hasat etmek için Element Z Çarpıştırıcısı ya da Element Z Rafinerisi inşa edin. Bu kaynağı arkadaşlarınızdan hediye olarak da alabilirsiniz.
Repel {total} invasions from Neighboring Empires to gain some confidence.
İstilacıları püskürtmeye yardım etmek için Arkadaşlarınızın İmparatorluklarını ziyaret edin.
The madman is trying to slow you down and split your resources. Don't let him get the better of you!
You were cool under fire! Good thing too, or we would have had a much harder job controlling the growing panic among the passengers! Thanks to you, the subway is functioning again.

The psychopath seized control of our Air Traffic Control Rooms and caused a mid-air collision of two aircrafts! Voyeur of destruction that he is, he's still in there, watching the damage unfold. We finally have him in our sights. Move in!
Ask for {total} Straitjackets. He's going to be locked up for a long time!
Fight the psychopath's security goons and win.
Deploy {total} Field Artillery Units to arm the high-security asylum guards.
Placing Field Artillery Units in your Empire is deployment. They can be built in your Army Barracks.
This guy always caused his mischief and scampered. Until now!
The madman's voyeuristic tendencies proved to be his undoing! Good job, Commander. I'm glad this whole thing is finally over!

The new batch of microchips came from my scientist friends in Veirra. They're the absolute latest in technology! But the Titans that have the new embedded chips haven't been functioning right during my tests...
You earned x5 SpecOps Platana Battleship!
The higher your game level, the better your reward! Players at levels 12 - 30 get version I of the SpecOps Platana Battleship; levels 31 - 50 get version II and levels 51+ get version III.
Hard-to-control Titans can only mean one thing: imminent disaster!
I'd ordered a new batch of specially engineered microchips to embed in a new batch of Titans. But something isn't right...
I've asked the team of scientists who worked on the microchips to visit my lab and help me out. Will you escort them here from the cold mountains of Veirra?
Amass {total} Bun Warmers to protect the scientists' rear flanks.
Collect from {total} Government Structures to finance the scientists' visit.
Toplamak için İmparatorluğunuzdaki Devlet Binalarına tıklayın.
Earn {total} Red Hearts to prove that you're a generous host.
Komşularınızı ziyaret edip onlara yardım edin veya Komşularınızın İmparatorluklarındaki istilaları püskürtün.
See that no harm comes to them as you travel. They rarely leave their lab in Veirra. This is a huge honor.
The Veirran scientists had much to say about what sounded like an uneventful journey. Thanks for treating them well, Commander!
The Veirran scientists did some tests and the Titans are ready to be taken out on a test run. Commander, look out! The Titans are going rogue on us! They're destroying my lab!
Ask for {total} Reassuring Pats to calm the scientists down while we handle the Titans.
Collect {total} {nrare2} because the scientists need it for their tests.
Bu cevher Süper Cevher Madeninizde üretilebilir, Komşulardan hasat edilip yağmalanabilir ya da savaşta kazanılabilir.
Harvest {total} Element Z, because rogue Titans will certainly lead to Titan fights.
Element Z hasat etmek için Element Z Çarpıştırıcısı ya da Element Z Rafinerisi inşa edin. Bu kaynağı arkadaşlarınızdan hediye olarak da alabilirsiniz.
I can't understand why this is happening! We must save the lab, Commander. Fight them!
You managed to force the Titans out of the lab but there was no way to prevent the damage they caused in the Empire. We were unprepared for this calamity, Commander.

We need to do some emergency damage control! The Titans went on a rampage over a part of the Empire, before departing to some unknown destination. Before we go after them, we must embark on relief missions for your citizens.
Get {total} Supply Drops for the stricken citizens.
Ask Friends for Supply Drops. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Harvest {total} Corn, to feed the frightened refugees.
Çiftliklerinize Mısır ekin ve hasat etmeden önce büyümesini bekleyin.
Your people need you, Commander. Our runaway Titans can wait.
Now that your citizens are taken care of, we have to deal with the rogue Titans who escaped from the Empire.

The scientists insist that certain circuits in those corrupted chips were tampered with AFTER they shipped them. Someone must have switched the packages... Aaaah, there's another one of those Titans! Defend yourself!
Ask for {total} Circuit Testers for the Veirran scientists to test their theory.
Ask Friends for Circuit Testers. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Build {total} Land Units as part of your defense against the Titan.
Land Units can be built in your Army Barracks.
Savaşta birliklerinizi akıllıca seçin. Kendi Titanlarınızı kullanmak size üstünlük sağlar.
My Veirran friends suspect foul play and I'm inclined to believe them.
We were better prepared for that attack this time. Now, follow that retreating Titan!

The Titan led us to a camp in a valley - it's a Dark Alliance camp led by Beau LeChomp! Somehow I'm never surprised to find the DA behind everything. Let's send a scout down into the camp and see what intel he brings back.
Collect {total} Microphone Bugs for our scout to plant around the camp.
Have a Titan Lab in your Empire. It always makes sense to build your own Titan.
If you haven't already placed the Titan Lab, you will find it in your Inventory, under the Buildings tab.
Build {total} Power-Ups. You must be prepared, when fighting Titans is involved.
Güçlendirici Fabrikanız yoksa inşa edebilirsiniz. Onu Envanterinizde Binalar sekmesinde bulacaksınız.
It's been a while since we last saw Beau. I must say he hasn't gotten any easier on the eyes...
Our scout discovered that LeChomp was the one who switched the microchip package the Veirrans sent, with a DA-tampered one. He now controls our Titans!
My Veirran buddies have been hard at work fixing up a new batch of microchips! You're going to have to sneak into the camp to try and replace the microchips in our Titans.
Collect {total} Sneak Suits to help us move in with stealth.
Ask Friends for Sneak Suits. You can also add more Neighbors through the World Parliament.
Build {total} Titan Atlas Heads to better equip your Titans, when you get them back.
An Atlas Head is a primary Titan Part that you can build in the Titan Lab.
Pillage {total} times to gather resources you need to build your own Titan.
Out with the old, in with the new. That's the plan!
Foiled! LeChomp caught on to our plan and set his Titans on us. It's a good thing you beat a hasty retreat when you did! Let's regroup and try something else.

It might be easier to tackle this situation on home ground. If we steal LeChomp's Element Z supplies and head back to our Empire, he'll be forced to follow us and get them back if he wants to replenish his almost run-down Titans.
Collect {total} Inert Containers to transport the stolen Element Z.
Donate {total} Titan Platings to the Vierrans to thank them for their help.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Deploy {total} Vintage Carriers in case LeChomp tries to approach by sea.
Placing Vintage Carriers in your Empire is deployment. Vintage Carriers are built in your Shipyard.
Element Z: every Titan's weakness. Let's cut off LeChomp's supply!
Yes! We've got LeChomp's entire supply of Element Z! It's only a matter of time now. He'll follow like a moth to a flame.
Let's set up a decoy Element Z reservoir for LeChomp to attack when he arrives. You keep him busy and I'll replace the microchips in the Titans... they should be out of juice by now. Let's get to it!
Collect {total} Engineers to help quickly build the decoy reservoir.
Use a Titan {total} times in battle, to scare LeChomp. Did he think you were helpless?
Use all the Element Z you just stole from LeChomp!
Savaşta birliklerinizi akıllıca seçin. Kendi Titanlarınızı kullanmak size üstünlük sağlar.
It's time to take a nice big bite out of LeChomp's forces... and his confidence!
Well played, Commander! Our Titans are under our control again. That has to be one for the books!
You have {num} Titan Platings. You need {total}.

Seriously?! Do terrorists think we'll just welcome them in? I have an idea! Let's pound them to pulp and then proceed to find and pulverize their main camp! We'll have to travel across some tough terrain! Up for the challenge Commander?
Players at levels 12 - 30 can win version I of the Mountain Fighter and Bird Killer; levels 31 - 50 can win version II and levels 51+ can win version III.
A dangerous terrorist group has set its sights on your Empire. Fighting is the only way to stay alive.

Commander {player_name}, our border security forces reported terrorist activity - radical nutcases who call themselves 'Democracy by Warfare'. Talk about stupid! Unfortunately, stupid often equals dangerous.
You earned 5x SpecOps Ankit UUV Patrol Boat!
Our border is being attacked by terrorists! You have to give them credit for their optimism. Let's show them exactly who they're messing with!
Get {total} Fake DBW Badges to fool the terrorists
Ask Friends for Fake DBW Badges.
Teach the terrorists at your border a lesson in the folly of overconfidence!
In all my years of service I've never seen the bad guys run so fast... and with their tails tucked firmly between their legs. Now, we march.

The DBW have retreated for now. We hear of an outpost of theirs close to our border.We should probably ask the neighbouring Varcadians to help us. It's their terrain of expertise and after all, their previous king was assassinated by these same terrorists.
Pick {total} Grunt Soldiers to send for help.
Harcanan kaynaklar kalıcı olarak gider, bu yüzden önce idare edecek kadar ek kaynağınız olduğundan emin olun.
Fight the Guards outside the outpost
Take out the last of the Guardians
Use Power-Ups to increase your chances of winning
While we ask for help from Varcadia, let's launch a full-scale attack on the terrorist outpost.
This feeling of being one up on the enemy is something I could get used to. Let's press forward to their camp!
Slow down! We're coming to a tribal village that's known for its hostility to visitors. These tribes are not known for their fun quotient. We have to run through them.
Get {total} Tranquiliser Bullets. We don't want to kill them, do we?
Trap the Soldiers they use to ambush travellers
Picking your Best Units leads to an early victory.
They have this local pastime. It's called 'Fighting'.
There's a tribal village trying to live up to negative stereotypes... their reputation. It's time to live up to ours.
Nice work. We won, but they did fight well. Let's see if we could train the survivors.
Looks are deceiving. That calm open valley we're about to cross could be crawling with terrorist ambush teams. Proceed with ultra-caution!
Take out the Ambush team attacking us from behind.
Use Power-Ups to increase your chances of winning.
Look ahead! There is a battle waiting for us.
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode. For Survival tips. We need them.
Tüm dalgaları tek seferde tamamlamanız gerekmiyor. Daha sonra gelip yeniden deneyebilirsiniz.
The open road is the most dangerous road. Look out for ambush teams.
I prefer mountains to valleys such as these. You know, the name "Death Valley" could have been our clue...
Another terrorist outpost? They have certainly been busy. Time to go all out with 'em big units.
Beat the forces they sent to 'take care' of you
Use Power-Ups to increase your chances of winning.
Take out the remaining forces within the post
Use Lightning Units to get extra energy for every hit!
Another outpost to destroy. Is it me or are these guys just so predictable?
Score one for our forces, zero for the terrorists. Wait, what's that right ahead? Their Camp!
Commander {user, name}, let's make history by making them... well, history!
string.variation: Commander {user,fem}, let's make history by making them... well, history!
Commander {user,masc}, let's make history by making them... well, history!

string.original: Shower bombs on the Demons these loons call units
Air Units can be built in your Hangar.
Get {total} Honour Pins for the celebrations
Give the 'Democracy by Warfare' terrorist group, a good reason to take up a new occupation!
Congratulations Commander {user,name}! You did it. Surviving members of Democracy by Warfare will have plenty of time to rethink their group name... in jail!
string.variation: Congratulations Commander {user,fem}! You did it. Surviving members of Democracy by Warfare will have plenty of time to rethink their group name... in jail!
Congratulations Commander {user,masc}! You did it. Surviving members of Democracy by Warfare will have plenty of time to rethink their group name... in jail!

string.original: There are several vantage points and plenty of places to hide among these mountains. Fighting them is literally going to be an uphill task.
There are spies here. Take them out.
Use Lightning Units to get extra energy for every hit!
More spies to take care of... wait, are they guards?
They've got air units stationed at the top! You know what to do.
Use Power-Ups to increase your chances of winning.
It feels like terrorists are easy to conquer. These mountains are much more difficult.

Tempers are flying high! In a TV interview, your Foreign Secretary accused an enemy nation of driving up petrol prices by hoarding oil supplies! This puts us in a very dangerous position! Deploy troops in case of potential problems.

Your Foreign Secretary is to be a buffoon. He has no idea bout strategic diplomacy. Get ready for trouble!

Use {total} Power-Ups in battle to teach the enemy a good lesson.

You didn't even break a sweat! Here's your prize: a pair of Rocket Buggies to let you really own the dunes.
Our orders take us back into Lestovia. In the heavily guarded bunkers of Area 15 lies a secret package known only as Ax23LV.
Cross the border and steer clear of the disaster of Area 36. The package Ax23LV in Area 15 is our target. The Dardo IFV is our prize.
Collect {total} Gun Silencers. Stealth is crucial in Lestovia.
No borders can hold you, Commander! But dangers lurk in every corner. Stay alert!
Bunker 3 holds what we're looking for. I hope you have enough ammo. There are guards aplenty.
According to our brief, Ax23LV is in Bunker 3. Be warned: it is heavily guarded.
That was quite the shootout! Let the smoke clear, Commander. Ax23LV is finally within our grasp.
Bunker 3 is ours to take. Ax23LV should be somewhere inside.
Besides a female prisoner, there's nothing resembling Ax23LV in here! Get yourselves out of there. You can question her later.
The prisoner. Azka. SHE was Ax23LV! That could have gone a whole different way.
I just heard that there's something very wrong with our Tatra Artillery units.
We'd fix the Tatra units ourselves but we can't understand a word in the Czech assembly manuals sent by the Tatra Company!
Good job! Now, can you say, "Let's blow something up!" in Czech? It seems like a useful phrase to learn.
B. F. Dealio is trying to get rid of the Caio Duilio ship he uses for his contraband. It's become too conspicuous.
Dealio wants to sell his ship in exchange for 100 ancient coins. But I know he's desperate. He'll sell for far less to be rid of it quickly.
What a bargain! Dealio sure was desperate to sell. It's in fine shape, this Duilio.
What's Azka's significance and why does everyone want her? You must find out. There's an Elite Atlay Main Battle Tank to be won.
Azka, is safe for the moment, but Lestovian rebels are marching on your army base. They mean to capture her.
Ask for {total} Thunderbolt Sirens to sound the alarm.
That was close! You managed to hold them off, but Azka is becoming a real enigma.
What now! Why are there enemy warplanes in your airspace? Azka's secret may hold the answers.
There's no time to strategize. Get your pilots on the move and fend off this air raid. And interrogate Azka without delay!
Azka is finally talking. I guess you won her trust. Now, let's find out what she has to say...
An implanted microchip holding top secret weapon designs? Now, isn't that always the way...?
Top secret plans for one of the deadliest weapons on earth are embedded on a chip implanted in Azka. Fight to protect her!
Now that we know Azka's secret, it's time for a decision: do we protect her at all costs or extract that information? To be continued...
After enjoying a joyride in one of our amphibious helicopters, I've decided to get one for myself.
I want to add some personal touches to my personal amphibious 'copter. I'm thinking something sea-themed...
Collect from houses {total} times. See if you can buy one
Build a Propeller Shop. Scarlett's experiments, I tell you!
Nice! I'm going to look so good in this. And I'm feeling generous so I got one for you too, Commander!
Seabolt claims he did a surgical rotation before giving up medicine in favor of... whatever it is he does now. I have a bad feeling about this...
Seabolt has made it his personal project to extract the Ax23LV chip that was implanted in Azka. Please keep an eye on him.
Commander, collect {total} Head CTs for Seabolt
Seabolt needs {total} Ore for... no reason
We're all prepped! Apart from his bedside manner, Seabolt seems to know what he's doing.
That Seabolt! I knew we should have kept a closer eye on him!
Seabolt left some scary instruments lying about and forgot to mention that the surgery would be minimally invasive. Now Azka's run away. Find her!
Gather {total} Oil. Send out a Search Party
Interrogate nicely... {total} WD wins would be sufficient
Repel {total} invasions. It's an art, really.
Lucky for us, Steele found Azka near the borders of his Empire. She's safe!
It's finally time to get that microchip out of Azka. We can only hope Seabolt can keep his eccentricities to a minimum.
Steele said he'll keep an eye on Seabolt during the extraction. You can make yourself useful elsewhere. I have a few errands for you.
Lestovian Bounty Hunters! Win {total} Battle Blitz fights
Perform {total} Army upgrade with the blueprints you found
Am I glad this is over. That microchip is finally in our hands and all's well!
A few of our neighbors don't understand what borders are for. Also, keep your eye out for an Elite Mongoose Attack Helicopter.
They're at it again, your pesky neighbors. Look, their Carrier is in your coastal territory. Send them a strong message.
Collect {total} Nautical Charts to pinpoint the enemy ship location
Deal {total} damage to Carriers using Fighters
Those Fighters you sent as a warning seem to have scared them off. Good!
They just launched their own war planes from the carrier. It's time to teach them a lesson they won't forget.
They think they're flying high, but the only thing that's soaring is their ego. You don't have time for this. Aim, lock target...Bam!
Deal {total} damage to pesky Air Units
There, I'll bet they're not quite so cocky now! But you never know. Stay focused.
I don't believe it, they seem to be courting a full-blown war. Off with the kid gloves. Hit 'em where it hurts!
Unbelievable! They've managed to cross your land borders and are creating a ruckus. They'll soon be sorry.
{total} Battle Blitz wins will send out a clear message...
Well done Commander. You defended your nation well. I doubt they'll be back. But then again, stupidity knows no boundaries.
Did you know Sarah has a thing for hogs? She's determined to take one of our Army Motorcycles out into the field for a test drive.
You should go with her, Commander. And arm yourself. Trouble finds her more often than you'd think!
Man, you must be glad to be back in one piece! Who knew Sarah had such a dangerous streak?
Commander, this is serious. We just discovered that someone downloaded a list of agent details from our Intelligence HQ server.
There's a mole in your Intelligence HQ. Code name: Vulture. He has downloaded agent details. Set a trap to find him.
Ask for {total} Internal Affairs Officers to investigate the leak.
Collect from {total} Government buildings. Get someone to talk.
It seems you've found your man. It's time to get a confession out of him.
Careful, a cornered man can be dangerous. And this one is particularly slippery.
You've trapped the mole but don't let your guard down, he's armed and he's dangerous. Get him before he gets away.
Ok, that was close. You have one officer wounded, but the traitor is now safely in your custody.
Commander, this isn't over. The mole leaked the names of our agents in the nation of Kalaha. They must be rescued!
You didn't have time to plug the leak and now your agents in Kalaha have been exposed. Pull them out ASAP!
Collect from {total} houses to fund the escape plan
Build {total} Land Units. You will need 'em.
Battle Blitz your way out. {total} wins should do
Well done! The Kalaha government is furious, but all your agents are safe.
Commander, there was a break in at your Arms Research Center. Five of your deadliest chemical weapons are missing.
Deadly chemical weapons have been stolen by your enemies. This. Will. Not. Do. Track them down, quick!
Collect {total} Antidote Kits to equip your spies.
Your spies did a good job of finding that secret facility in the desert. Now you can take them by surprise.
Oh no, you lost the element of surprise. There's no time to waste. You must destroy the facility along with the weapons.
Your men were spotted while sneaking up on the enemy. Now you have no choice but to destroy the facility and the weapons. Unleash!
As well as this is going, you're going to need air support if you want to get this job done.
Fall back, Commander. Get to safety while your Air Force blows them into oblivion.
Some strategic bombs dropped by your Air Force will do the trick. They don't stand a chance.
Fantastic! The only trace of your enemies and their threat is a smoking heap of nothing! You managed to avert a deadly disaster.
We're in for a bit of a history lesson. I ran into some descendants of the Conte di Cavour and invited them over for dinner.
A military exercise based on the Italian Unification sounds interesting... after dinner with our guests of course.
Our Italian guests left us a rather extravagant gift - their Cavour Carrier!
Commander, we just received intel that an extremist group will detonate a bomb on the 4th of July. We don't know when or where.
Extremists have threatened to mar our 4th of July celebrations with a deadly bomb explosion. You must stop them!
Collect {total} Firework Rockets for your celebrations.
Good work Commander. Your agents managed to find out that the bomb will go off during the fireworks display.
Double your security at the fireworks display venue. Keep your guards on high alert. Shoot on sight if you spot a suspect.
The suspects will try and hide the bomb at the venue. You must shoot on sight. This is an explosive situation in more ways than one.
Deploy {total} Grunt Soldiers. Keep a close watch.
Complete {total} waves of Survival Mode. Get Ready.
That was a close shave Commander. You took down the enemy extremists, disarmed the bomb and struck a real blow for freedom.
Fanatics! Because you squashed their bomb plot, they intend to attack on a larger scale. Get them before they get you.
The extremists want revenge! They're planning a large-scale attack. You now know their hideout. Outsmart and destroy them.
They never saw you coming! Well done Commander. Now you can enjoy your celebration of freedom. You certainly earned it.
Commander, the delegation exhibiting the ancient Ruby of Lestovia has been attacked. A Dragonfly (470) will be yours if you save this situation.
Up the security for the delegation from Lestovia. It looks like someone objects to the exhibition of their sacred Ruby here.
Collect {total} Pedestal Cases to exhibit the sacred Ruby
Build a Park Gazebo for the visiting delegation
This is strange indeed. I didn't expect the exhibition of the Ruby to be this difficult. Keep your eyes open!
We must take out a heavy water production plant located in enemy territory. A Foreign Legionnaire is waiting for you.
For Phase 1 of Operation Heavyside, we're going to have to drop a special advanced force into the area along with supplies.
Collect {total} CLE Containers for the supplies
I knew all those airborne transport exercises would serve us well. Stay alert, this is hostile territory.
Your men have a rough way ahead of them, Commander!
Ford the river and approach the plant via the hill on the far side. Take out the watchtower and your way will be clear.
Pillage {total} times on your way. Fun stuff.
Build a Strike Team. Watch. Tower. Kaboom!
Excellent! The plant is yours to take - just watch your step around all those explosives you're carrying!
Now that the plant is within your reach, your target is the electrolysis chamber!
A cable tunnel will lead you to the main basement. Set up the explosive charges around the electrolysis chambers and get out of there!
Use one Strike Team. Then, Take a step back
I love the sound of exploding production plants. It feels like an early Christmas!
Revolutionists have assassinated the Premier of Port Sylvan! Keep your eye out for violence and a Scorpion Tank.
We should keep a task force ready to help in case more violence breaks out there. Wait, why are we under attack?
Collect {total} E-Alerts for updates on the situation
They're attacking! Win {total} Battle Blitz Fights
That was unexpected. You must find out why a group of Port Sylvan revolutionists would attack us after the assassination of their Premier!
I know why we were attacked by the revolutionists. We have a rather important refugee on our hands.
The Port Sylvan General Secretary is seeking asylum in our Empire. We must protect him. The attempts on his life haven't ceased!
You've got the situation in your Empire under temporary control, but this is far from over.
It's time to put a stop to this uprising. The Port Sylvans just want the violence to end...
The people of Port Sylvan are trying to reinstate their Government. Take as many men as you need and help them overthrow the revolutionists!
You worked fast and well, commander! The General Secretary has been reinstated and Port Sylvan is back on its feet.
Are you willing to really get your hands dirty?
A Vulture Copter could be yours if you can find me enough fake carcasses. Yes, I know it isn't Halloween yet. Stop asking questions!
Build {total} Fighters. They take down Airships.
Enjoy your Vulture Copter! No bald bird can resist the lure of a carcass... fake though it may be.
I'm taking Scarlett out for a private screening of her favorite Opera - Die Fledermaus. I've got a surprise in store for her!
I want a cloud of bats to fly out from the curtains during the final act of Die Fledermaus. Scarlett loves a good fright... I think.
Collect {total} Bats to surprise Scarlett with
Scarlett didn't appreciate the scare at all! She set a Fledermaus Fighter on me. You should take it away before she comes back!
The children of our Ambassador to Isla Azul are being held hostage along with others in their school! The Ambassador is distraught!
A terrorist outfit has taken over a small school in Isla Azul. Set up a security cordon around the school and prepare for negotiations.
The terrorists will only agree to meet a certain diplomat. We might be able to negotiate the release of some of the children...
It's important to get the children out. Sacrifices will have to be made.
The terrorists will negotiate only with a certain diplomat of Isla Azul. Find out what they want and try to get the kids released.
Pillage {total} times while searching for him
Gather from houses {total} times. Trade for the Children.
The terrorists want the formal independence of a minor state within Isla Azul. They released the kids and are now holding the diplomat inside.
We're only responsible for the life of the diplomat now. I think we can take control of this situation.
Here's the plan: we'll pump a chemical agent into the building while you take a squad and get the diplomat out. Don't forget the extra gas mask!
It was touch and go there with that chemical gas but you got the diplomat out safe. I salute you, Commander!
I fear we may have sent some of our commandos and fighters on a suicide mission. They are in serious trouble in enemy territory.
Coded messages detailing the mission and location of our units were intercepted and cracked. We need a new encryption system.
Collect {total} Navajo Code Talkers to send out new, secure messages
Build {total} Grunt Soldiers. They make good messengers.
The Navajo code talkers dispatched messages that led our troops to secure shelters!
Oh dear, I've just received some bad news about one of our code talkers.
One of our code talkers is being held hostage in the enemy camp. We must get to him before he breaks under torture!
We've discovered our code talker's location. If the enemy wants him to decipher a message, we'll give them a message!
If they think they can mess with our little code ninjas, they're in for a nasty surprise!
The Navajos' code is so precise, they can send a message within a message: one to throw off the captors and one to aid our rescue!
Success! All our Navajo code ninjas are home safe thanks to you!
I've heard some disturbing reports coming from certain areas of the Empire. Please investigate; this looks serious.
Rumors of a human trafficking ring have reached my ears. You might want to do a little digging around.
Collect {total} Census Reports to cross-check against your citizens
So it's true. People have been disappearing but nobody is filing a report because they're scared. This is really bad...
I think we've found the common denominator among all the missing people!
All the missing people were working at an arms factory here. Go in and question the manager, but stay vigilant! He looks like a smarmy one.
I didn't think the manager would pull out his big guns at the sight of you! You got out just in time!
Now that we're sure we've found the trafficking ring, let's take it out at the center!
We now know our target: the arms factory and its manager. I've got the employees out. Get your guns blazing and take it down!
That was almost text book perfect! We still have to find those missing people, but the time will come for that!
We're heading back into Lestovia. Our mission is to climb Karmen's Peak and neutralize three enemy bunkers at the top.
Careful, the hill is a sheer, 100 ft. cliff face of solid ice and we have no cover from enemies stationed on adjacent hills.
Collect {total} Ice Axes to aid your climb
Win {total} Battle Blitz Fights. There's an attack from Adjacent Hills!
Thanks for having my back! I think we've taken care of the hostile units on adjacent cliffs, but we've lost all but 6 men in this encounter.
Our losses have been heavy, but we must continue, Commander.
We've lost the element of surprise. The nearest bunker at the top has been alerted and they're opening machine gun fire on us. Retaliate!
That's one bunker down! Take cover, Commander, the next two aren't any friendlier.
We're running low on ammo and the enemy has the long-range advantage.
We must split up. I'll take bunker two while you engage bunker three. It's time to go all 'Braveheart' on them.
I'll be honest; I didn't think our mad assault would hold up against those odds. But we did it!
We're going to intercept a ring of rascals dealing in large wild cat trade. They're doing a 'roaring' business!
These are a cagey lot so be careful. The rescued animals will be shipped off to a wildlife conservation preserve.
Collect {total} Rescue Cages to transport the animals to safety
They had more than live tigers. We've confiscated some cool weapons, including an Elite King Tiger Tank.
Commander, there's been a break in at the state treasury. Gold bricks worth billions are gone. We must find out who did this and how!
Interrogate all staff starting with the Minister. The thieves had inside help. Complete the Billions in Bullion mission to get an Elite Yamato!
Collect {total} Interrogation Specialists to extract the truth
This is terrible! We found a traitorous Finance Minister, and the enemy he gave the vault codes to, will use our gold to buy weapons to destroy us!
Send a warning message to the thieving enemy nation. If they don't give back the gold, you'll make them pay. The cost of theft will be war!
The enemy who stole your bullion must be taught a lesson. Give them fair warning. If the gold is returned, you won't wage war. Let's hope they do the smart thing!
Earn {total} Black Hearts. That'll threaten them
That's rich! You gave them a golden opportunity to redeem themselves and they're refusing to take it. They don't stand a chance!
Set a shining example for other potential thieves. This is what happens when someone steals your gold reserves. Hit the thieving nation hard Commander!
Nobody steals your gold and gets away with it! The thieves will learn that the hard way. Launch an attack. Make them pay...with war!
That's that then. Good show! You got your gold back and left your enemy cowering in a corner. They won't mess with you again!
Commander, our enemy took control of our weapons satellite! They are threatening to change coordinates of any missile we launch, so it targets our ally.
Kidnap enemy leaders to use as bargaining chips in this missile control issue. Complete The Terror Coordinates mission to get a Flying Fox Fighter!
Collect {total} Satellite Scientists to study the issue
Your commandos did a commendable job, Commander. The enemy never saw them coming. Now let's set some terms and conditions.
The threat of redirected missiles is neutralized for the moment, but now the enemy is fighting mad. If a fight is what they want, that's what they'll get.
The enemy is attacking! They're pretty mad at us for kidnapping their leaders and thus neutralizing their missile manipulation threat. Fight back!
Good show Commander. They've retreated for the moment. They won't dare try their missile stunt now, let's finish this quick!
Commander I'm confident they won't make any stupid moves while we have their leaders. Teach them not to mess with us again. Launch a missile!
You must launch a missile to do some damage to the enemy nation. They won't do anything to jeopardize their leaders. Let it be a final warning.
That last blow brought them to their senses! They've relinquished control of the satellite. Now send their leaders back to them!
Commander, our source says that arms smugglers are docking in our harbor. We must locate them and nip this in the bud.
Those spot checks paid off. We found crates filled with parts to build Armadillo Artillery units, aboard the Sea Armor. Smugglers have no imagination!
Collect {total} Crowbars to pry open crates during the spot checks.
The smugglers found themselves in hot water when they lingered in our waters. They won't try that again!
A rap on the knuckles can often straighten out an errant neighbor. It's time to impose a trade embargo against the island of Bulova.
Call a press conference to announce why we're imposing a trade embargo against Bulova. Finish The Embargo Imbroglio quest to get a German KSK.
Collect {total} Newspapers that carried an article about the embargo.
Your announcement made front page news Commander! It's only a matter of time before Bulova comes around.
Commander, we just intercepted some unethical merchants doing trade with Bulova behind our backs. They're refusing to surrender.
We caught some merchants red-handed while they were shipping goods to Bulova. They just fired at us. We'll have to retaliate.
Oh good, the merchant ships are standing down. Thankfully there aren't too many casualties. Let's bring them in.
What now? It seems a Bulovian ship waiting to take delivery of the goods, has entered the fray. They're shooting. Fire back!
The Bulovians got a rude shock when we stopped the delivery of goods. They're gunning for trouble by trying to attack us. Let's end this!
Done and dusted Commander! It won't be long now before Bulova enters into an amicable treaty with us!
Commander, get down! Enemy forces just dropped a bomb in the middle of our ally's festive celebrations. Radio our air force for assistance.
Enemies dropped a bomb in the midst of our ally's celebrations. Call in our air force. Complete the Festivities Furor quest to get a Sky Whale Bomber.
Collect {total} Diplomatic Gifts to present to your ally
Take cover, Commander! Our Air Force is on its way. Let's teach these spoilsports a lesson.
Our air force has arrived! Oh no, there's total chaos. They're attacking our ally's forces instead of the enemy bombers!
Our men got here quick, but they are mistakenly attacking our ally instead of the enemy. Radio our squadron leader now!
You got the message across! If we combine forces with our ally, the enemy won't stand a chance.
Together with our ally, we're a real force to reckon with. The enemy had better tuck their tails in and run!
The enemy will regret ruining this celebration! Now that we've joined forces with our ally, there's no stopping us.
We did it! Let's help our friends salvage what's left of their celebration. The festivities furor is finally over!
Commander, our ally's carrier seems deserted. Launch the boats. We must board her to find out what's going on.
It's an ambush. Our enemies disguised the carrier to look like it belonged to our ally. We almost fell into their cunning trap.
Collect {total} pairs of Giant Navy Binoculars to check for life onboard the carrier.
We're under attack! Win {total} Battle Blitz Fights
They certainly didn't expect us to fight back so hard. The rewards of success are sweet. We just added a Stonefish Carrier to our navy.
Commander, I have bad news. One of our top scientists is missing. I fear he was abducted by enemy forces. You must launch an investigation.
Find out if your top scientist was kidnapped by enemies. Complete The Abduction Ordeal quests to win a Red SU-122 Tank.
Collect {total} DNA Samples from the kidnap crime scene
Harvest {total} houses for coins to fund the search
From DNA samples found at the kidnapping site, we've know that Professor Von Helmen is behind this. Let's find him and rescue our scientist.
We found Professor Von Helmen holed up in a faraway hideout. He's forcing our scientist to divulge technological secrets. Let's take him down.
Professor Von Helmen's hideout has been discovered. Surround him and launch a surprise attack. Keep our scientist safe!
Your troop hit the hideout hard, but the Professor took to his heels and fled. Send some men after him and take our scientist home.
The Professor's helicopter was tracked to the mountains of Knora. His men are firing at us. Retaliate!
The Professor escaped by helicopter to the mountains of Knora. His men are attacking. You must defeat them.
Well, the Professor escaped again, but his cronies are in custody and our scientist is safe. Good work Commander!
Commander, we just took the lead in this battle. Send out our squadron for one last bomb run and watch the enemy retreat!
One last bomb run should do the trick Commander. Victory is almost ours. Complete the Flying Faker quests to win an Elite I400 Sub Carrier.
Collect {total} Radio Coverage Maps to try and track the missing pilot.
We did it Commander, but one of our planes never made it back. There's no sign of the pilot. He may have been captured.
Commander, our pilot may be a prisoner of war. We know where the enemy's camp is. Let's take this fight to them.
Attack the enemy camp! It's possible that our pilot has been imprisoned there. We're not going to take that lying down!
Great work on breaching the enemy camp walls. This fight should be over quick.
Commander, you're not going to like this. We just spotted our pilot, but he's no prisoner. It looks like he's working with the enemy.
Your pilot appears to be a turncoat. This is too much! Defeat the enemy and take the traitor prisoner.
The farce is over! The double-crossing pilot will have plenty of time to think about loyalty, while behind bars. Good work Commander.
Commander, soldiers from our enemy's Leatherback Carrier are fishing in our waters, for a mascot - a protected Leatherback Turtle!
The enemy will never forget this lesson in marine conservation. We taught it to them, by rescuing the turtles and taking over their Carrier.
Ask for {total} Marine Conservationists to keep an eye on the protected turtles.
Well done Commander! Our conservationists are breathing easy again. It doesn't hurt that you've added a Leatherback Carrier to your fleet.
Commander, I got a warning from your ally. A radical group is portraying him as a warmonger, during elections. They may attack you and blame him!
Be warned! A radical group may attack you and blame your ally, so he loses an election. Complete The Political Plot quests to win a Union Infantry.
Collect {total} Propaganda Posters that portray your ally as a warmonger.
You have your forces standing by and ready to repel an attack. That's good! The waiting is hardest.
The docks were just bombed! It's a good thing you're on high alert. This is the radical group attack I warned you about.
The radicals just bombed your docks. Counterattack at once! It's a good thing you were warned in advance!
Counter the attackers at the dock
They're coming back again for another attack. Don't let them get anywhere near your shore. Fight back!
Fight to prove a point. Also fight to clear the tarnished reputation of your ally. You must defeat the radicals!
These radicals stand for everything you oppose. Teach them a lesson in fair play and fair elections.
They have landed on your shore. Fight!
Take out the last of the attackers
It's finally over. The battle was short but hard won! Your ally will be pleased Commander. You struck a blow for friendship.
Commander. We have a hostage situation onboard a naval ship. The pirates were in a submarine! Our men were taken by surprise.
Submarine pirates took over a naval ship after a brief fight. They want money! Complete The Underwater Operation quests to win a HL Hunley Submarine!
Collect {total} Pirate Flags as part of your study of the enemy
Call in pirate negotiators. Try talking first. If that fails, force will be required. An elite force is ready to strike.
It's not your style to buckle under Commander. The pirates' submarine is close by the hostage ship. If we move fast, we can take it over.
While the pirates are busy with their hostages, launch a sneak attack on their submarine. Move fast and take it over!
Deal {total} damage with your Sea Units
Nice work. That was quick and smooth. The pirates didn't have a chance to react. You're now on equal footing.
Imagine that, the chief pirate's daughter was in their submarine. Let's see what he thinks about fair exchange!
You found the chief pirate's daughter in the submarine. Distract him with this dilemma, while your Commandos sneak aboard the naval ship.
The battle was fast and fierce and your Commandos outdid themselves. Nice going! You really sank the pirates' plan.
Commander, a rogue pilot from the neighboring dictatorship is in our air space. He's not attacking though!
The rogue pilot just radioed in asking for refuge. He wants to defect from the dictatorship. He brings a gift - the Gyrfalcon 02 VTOL he escaped in!
Collect {total} Air Traffic Controllers to monitor the rogue pilot.
Well, that's one fighter less for the enemy dictator and one new citizen for the Empire! Welcome the pilot and accept his gift.
This is rich! Our local eccentric millionaire bought an island outside our jurisdiction. He's storing his prized collection of war units out there!
Your Empire's resident eccentric millionaire is collecting war units! He's storing them on an island beyond your jurisdiction. You can't do a thing!
Collect {total} Tracking Chips to keep tabs on the eccentric millionaire.
There is something you can do Commander. Track him, monitor him and make sure you know his every move!
Commander, our fears were founded! A gun runner helping the millionaire with his collection, has imprisoned him and taken over the island.
A gun runner has imprisoned the millionaire and laid claim to his island and arms collection. Prepare to repel an imminent attack!
Fight the gun runner and win.
It's a good thing you were expecting trouble Commander. Well done on repelling the gun runner's first attack!
It's your turn! You must go on the offensive and attack the island. Destroy the millionaire's collection and rescue him!
The millionaire got himself into this trouble and you must get him out! Launch an attack on the island and rescue him!
Battle the gun runner again and win.
That's that! Commander, you and your men did a great job! Let's just hope no more eccentricities emerge in your Empire.
Commander, it was a sneak attack! Enemy forces just took over one of our lumber mills. Our men fought hard but lost.
Enemy forces caught you off guard. They've taken over one of your lumber mills. Stop this resource robbery at once!
Collect {total} Lumberjacks to rescue from the melee.
Fight the force that took over your lumber mill.
Your soldiers really know their stuff Commander. That was a brilliant battle. You took back your mill in style!
Commander, this seems to be a planned effort to damage us. Enemy fighters just bombed one of our ore mines!
Call in your air force. The enemy just bombed one of your ore mines. This attack has been well planned. You cannot let them win!
Well done! That's the last of the enemy fighters down and out. But hold on, we just got news of trouble at sea
This time it's an offshore oil rig that's been attacked. Our navy must go on the offense at once. Be careful not to hit the rig!
Alert your navy! They must defeat the enemy forces that attacked your offshore oil rig. These robbers are going to pay!
Fight the resource thieves, at sea.
Yes! Three down, none to go! Those resource thieves are not coming back in a hurry! Nice work Commander.
Commander, remember those weapons' plans the traitor scientist sold to the enemy? Well, it's time for revenge!
Your enemy is shipping a Scorpion Artillery unit to their troops in a war zone. They stole the plans for that unit. Take it by force!
Collect {total} Microfilm Rolls, sent by your spies within the enemy force.
Fight the enemy at sea and win.
They say that revenge is a dish best served cold and they're right about that. The rewards of revenge are rather good too!
Commander, the Karnovian Ambassador is here with his entourage. Make him feel welcome, as long as he keeps off the topic of prisoners!
